meta.noteEn: Original questions organised by AET PCP course module (field 'aet'). Not AET's own quiz items. Batch 3: modules 7B, 7C-A, 7D-B, 7C-B and 8B.
meta.noteZh: 按 AET PCP 课程模块编排的原创题（字段 aet）。不是学校原题。第三批：7B、7C-A、7D-B、7C-B、8B 五门。

questions.questionEn: Under the BC examination guidelines, which of these patients meets the criteria to start CPAP?
questions.questionZh: 按 BC 考纲，下列哪位患者符合启动 CPAP 的条件？

options.en: A 10-year-old asthmatic, alert, RR 30, SpO₂ 90% on oxygen, accessory muscle use
options.zh: 10 岁哮喘患儿，清醒，RR 30，吸氧下 SpO₂ 90%，有辅助呼吸肌参与

options.en: A 58-year-old in heart failure, alert, RR 28, SpO₂ 89% on oxygen, accessory muscle use
options.zh: 58 岁心衰患者，清醒，RR 28，吸氧下 SpO₂ 89%，有辅助呼吸肌参与

options.en: A 70-year-old with COPD, drowsy, RR 8, shallow breaths, SpO₂ 85% on oxygen
options.zh: 70 岁 COPD 患者，嗜睡，RR 8，呼吸浅，吸氧下 SpO₂ 85%

options.en: A 45-year-old with chest-wall bruising after a crash, alert, RR 26, SpO₂ 91% on oxygen
options.zh: 45 岁车祸后胸壁挫伤，清醒，RR 26，吸氧下 SpO₂ 91%

questions.explanationEn: The BC CPAP criteria are: age 13 or older, in significant respiratory distress, awake and following commands, able to maintain a patent airway, and showing all three of RR above 24, SpO₂ below 94% on oxygen, and accessory muscle use. The 58-year-old ticks every box. The 10-year-old is excluded by age (12 and under is a contraindication) even though the numbers fit. The drowsy COPD patient with slow, shallow breathing is in respiratory failure — he needs BVM ventilation, not CPAP. A traumatic cause of respiratory distress is also a listed contraindication, and a bruised chest wall may hide a pneumothorax that positive pressure would worsen.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的 CPAP 指征：13 岁及以上、明显呼吸窘迫、清醒且能听从指令、能维持气道通畅，并且同时满足 RR >24、吸氧下 SpO₂ <94%、有辅助呼吸肌参与这三条。58 岁这位每一条都符合。10 岁患儿数字虽然都对，却因年龄被排除（12 岁及以下是禁忌）。嗜睡、呼吸慢而浅的 COPD 患者已经是呼吸衰竭，需要 BVM 通气而不是 CPAP。创伤引起的呼吸窘迫也在禁忌名单上，而且胸壁挫伤下面可能藏着气胸，正压会让它恶化。

questions.questionEn: You are starting CPAP on a patient with acute pulmonary edema. According to the BC guideline, how do you begin and how high may you go?
questions.questionZh: 你准备给急性肺水肿患者上 CPAP。按 BC 考纲，起始怎么设、最高能调到多少？

options.en: Start at 10 cmH₂O and increase by 5 cmH₂O to a maximum of 20
options.zh: 从 10 cmH₂O 开始，每次加 5，最高 20

options.en: Start at 2.5 cmH₂O and increase by 2.5 cmH₂O to a maximum of 15
options.zh: 从 2.5 cmH₂O 开始，每次加 2.5，最高 15

options.en: Start at 7.5 cmH₂O with 7 L/min oxygen and hold it for transport
options.zh: 7.5 cmH₂O、氧流量 7 L/min 起步，转运途中保持不变

options.en: Start at 5 cmH₂O with 5 L/min oxygen, increasing by 2.5 to a maximum of 10
options.zh: 5 cmH₂O、氧流量 5 L/min 起步，每次加 2.5，最高 10

questions.explanationEn: BC CPAP use: start at 5 L/min with the valve at 5 cmH₂O, obtain a facial seal, reassess the patient and vitals, then repeat in 2.5 cmH₂O increments to a maximum of 10 cmH₂O. The guideline's setting table pairs each pressure with an oxygen flow (5 → 5 L/min, 7.5 → 7 L/min, 10 → 8 L/min). Starting at 10 or titrating to 15–20 exceeds the BC ceiling and risks hypotension and gastric insufflation; 2.5 cmH₂O is below the starting pressure; and a fixed 7.5 setting with no reassessment misses both the chance to titrate and the signs of deterioration.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的 CPAP 操作：氧流量 5 L/min、阀门 5 cmH₂O 起步，扣好面罩密封，复评患者和生命体征，再以 2.5 cmH₂O 为步长上调，最高 10 cmH₂O。考纲的设置表把每个压力和氧流量配对（5 → 5 L/min，7.5 → 7 L/min，10 → 8 L/min）。从 10 起步或调到 15–20 超出了 BC 的上限，容易导致低血压和胃胀气；2.5 cmH₂O 低于起始压力；固定 7.5 不再复评，既错过滴定的机会，也会漏掉恶化的征象。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old on CPAP for pulmonary edema was improving. Ten minutes later her SBP has fallen from 118 to 84 and she is becoming confused. What should you do now?
questions.questionZh: 72 岁女性因肺水肿上了 CPAP，起初好转。10 分钟后 SBP 从 118 掉到 84，人开始糊涂。现在该怎么做？

options.en: Remove the CPAP and ventilate with a BVM, no PEEP valve while SBP is below 90
options.zh: 撤掉 CPAP，用 BVM 通气，SBP 低于 90 期间不接 PEEP 阀

options.en: Increase the CPAP to 10 cmH₂O and raise the oxygen flow to 8 L/min
options.zh: 把 CPAP 调到 10 cmH₂O，氧流量加到 8 L/min

options.en: Keep the CPAP on and give a 500 mL fluid bolus, reassessing before the next 500
options.zh: 继续 CPAP，给 500 mL 液体冲击，下一个 500 前复评

options.en: Switch to a non-rebreather at 15 L/min with a nasal cannula at 15 L/min underneath
options.zh: 换成 15 L/min 非重复呼吸面罩，下面再加 15 L/min 鼻导管

questions.explanationEn: Two CPAP contraindications have appeared: SBP below 90 mmHg and a falling level of consciousness. The guideline says that if the patient deteriorates, remove the CPAP and ventilate with a BVM (consider a PEEP valve only if indicated) — and the PEEP rule says to remove the valve if SBP drops below 90 or the patient arrests. So it is BVM ventilation without PEEP for now. Turning the pressure up to 10 would drop her venous return and BP further. A fluid bolus is for hypovolemia and would worsen pulmonary edema — her problem is pump failure, not an empty tank. The non-rebreather-plus-cannula step belongs to the oxygen ladder for a patient who is still breathing adequately; it does not support a failing ventilatory effort.
questions.explanationZh: 两条 CPAP 禁忌已经出现：SBP 低于 90 mmHg，以及意识水平下降。考纲写明：患者恶化就撤掉 CPAP、改用 BVM 通气（有指征才考虑 PEEP 阀）；而 PEEP 的规则是 SBP 低于 90 或心搏骤停时要摘掉阀门。所以此刻是不带 PEEP 的 BVM 通气。把压力调到 10 会进一步减少静脉回流、压低血压。液体冲击是给低血容量用的，只会加重肺水肿——她的问题是泵衰竭，不是容量空了。「非重复呼吸面罩叠加鼻导管」是给仍能有效自主呼吸的患者用的氧疗阶梯，撑不住正在衰竭的通气。

questions.questionEn: Which set of PEEP-valve instructions matches the BC guideline for bag-valve-mask ventilation?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪组 PEEP 阀操作要点符合 BC 考纲对 BVM 通气的规定？

options.en: Oxygen inlet, 10 cmH₂O to start, 10–12 breaths per minute, maximum 15 cmH₂O
options.zh: 接氧气入口，10 cmH₂O 起步，通气 10–12 次/分，最高 15 cmH₂O

options.en: Exhaust port, 5 cmH₂O to start, 20 breaths per minute to overcome the added resistance
options.zh: 接呼气口，5 cmH₂O 起步，通气 20 次/分以克服增加的阻力

options.en: Exhaust port, 5 cmH₂O to start, no more than 8–10 breaths per minute, maximum 10 cmH₂O
options.zh: 接呼气口，5 cmH₂O 起步，通气不超过 8–10 次/分，最高 10 cmH₂O

options.en: Exhaust port, 7.5 cmH₂O to start, 12 breaths per minute, keep it on if SBP falls below 90
options.zh: 接呼气口，7.5 cmH₂O 起步，通气 12 次/分，SBP 低于 90 也继续用

questions.explanationEn: The BC PEEP steps: attach the valve to the BVM exhaust port, dial 5 cmH₂O, hold a good seal, ventilate at an appropriate rate (usually no more than 8–10 breaths per minute), watch SpO₂ and blood pressure, and increase in 2.5 cmH₂O increments to a maximum of 10. If the patient becomes hypotensive (SBP under 90) or goes into cardiac arrest, remove the valve. The valve works on exhaled gas, so the oxygen inlet is the wrong port and 15 cmH₂O exceeds the ceiling. Twenty breaths per minute is hyperventilation, which raises intrathoracic pressure and cuts venous return — the added resistance is the point of PEEP, not something to overcome. Starting at 7.5 skips the first step, and keeping PEEP on through hypotension is exactly what the guideline forbids.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的 PEEP 步骤：阀门接在 BVM 的呼气口，调到 5 cmH₂O，保持良好密封，用合适频率通气（通常不超过 8–10 次/分），监测 SpO₂ 和血压，以 2.5 cmH₂O 递增、最高 10。患者出现低血压（SBP 低于 90）或心搏骤停就摘掉阀门。阀门作用于呼出气，所以氧气入口是错的接口，15 cmH₂O 也超出了上限。20 次/分是过度通气，会升高胸内压、减少静脉回流——阻力增加正是 PEEP 的目的，不是要去克服的东西。从 7.5 起步跳过了第一步，而低血压时继续用 PEEP 恰恰是考纲禁止的。

questions.questionEn: A 24-year-old with severe asthma has had two salbutamol nebulizers and one dose of ipratropium. He can now only speak single words, SpO₂ is 88% on oxygen, and the wheeze you heard earlier is getting quieter. What is the PCP's next intervention under the BC protocol?
questions.questionZh: 24 岁重症哮喘患者已雾化两次沙丁胺醇和一次异丙托溴铵。现在只能说单个字，吸氧下 SpO₂ 88%，之前听到的哮鸣音反而越来越弱。按 BC 规程，PCP 下一步做什么？

options.en: Epinephrine 0.5 mg IM
options.zh: 肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg

options.en: A second dose of ipratropium 500 mcg by nebulizer
options.zh: 再雾化一次异丙托溴铵 500 mcg

options.en: CPAP at 5 cmH₂O with 5 L/min oxygen
options.zh: 5 cmH₂O、氧流量 5 L/min 的 CPAP

options.en: Dexamethasone 8 mg PO
options.zh: 地塞米松 8 mg 口服

questions.explanationEn: A quietening wheeze in a tiring asthmatic is an ominous sign — less air is moving, not less bronchospasm. The BC SOB protocol tells the PCP to give IM epinephrine for severe disease or imminent respiratory failure, specifically when SpO₂ is below 90% and/or moderate-to-severe bronchospasm is unresolved after salbutamol; the monograph dose is 0.5 mg IM every 5–20 minutes, and you should be preparing to assist ventilations at the same time. Ipratropium is a single-dose administration and cannot be repeated. CPAP may be considered, but it is contraindicated once the patient is in imminent respiratory failure, so it does not come before epinephrine here. Dexamethasone takes hours to work and is an adjunct, not a rescue.
questions.explanationZh: 哮喘患者越来越疲惫、哮鸣音反而变弱，是凶险信号——是进出的气少了，不是痉挛缓解了。BC 的呼吸困难规程规定：重症或即将呼吸衰竭时 PCP 给肌注肾上腺素，具体指标是 SpO₂ 低于 90% 和/或沙丁胺醇后中重度支气管痉挛仍未缓解；药物单上的剂量是 0.5 mg 肌注，每 5–20 分钟一次，同时要做好辅助通气的准备。异丙托溴铵只给一次，不能重复。CPAP 可以考虑，但患者一旦濒临呼吸衰竭就是禁忌，所以此时排不到肾上腺素前面。地塞米松要几个小时才起效，是辅助用药，不是救命药。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old with COPD is short of breath, using accessory muscles, SpO₂ 86% on room air. What does the BC oxygen administration guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 70 岁 COPD 患者呼吸困难，辅助呼吸肌参与，室内空气下 SpO₂ 86%。BC 的氧疗指南怎么规定？

options.en: Nasal cannula at 1–3 L/min from the start, since high flow suppresses his hypoxic drive
options.zh: 一开始就只用鼻导管 1–3 L/min，因为高流量会抑制他的低氧呼吸驱动

options.en: Nasal cannula at 2 L/min, titrated to an SpO₂ of 88–92%
options.zh: 鼻导管 2 L/min，滴定到 SpO₂ 88–92%

options.en: Simple face mask at 4 L/min, titrated to an SpO₂ of 94%
options.zh: 简单面罩 4 L/min，滴定到 SpO₂ 94%

options.en: High-flow oxygen titrated to SpO₂ 94%, then nasal cannula 1–3 L/min
options.zh: 高流量氧滴定到 SpO₂ 94%，之后再降为鼻导管 1–3 L/min

questions.explanationEn: The guideline states that high-flow oxygen is indicated for COPD patients complaining of shortness of breath, and that the 1–3 L/min nasal cannula rate applies after acute care treatment with high-flow oxygen if that was required. Any patient who is short of breath, in shock or has CO poisoning gets high-flow oxygen titrated to 94%. The 'hypoxic drive' fear is not a reason to under-treat an acutely hypoxic patient; the guideline manages the risk by titrating and then stepping down, not by withholding. A face mask below 6 L/min is never used. Note the course-versus-exam difference: the AET glossary teaches a COPD target of 88–92%; the EMALB examination guideline titrates to 94% — use the exam figure on the licensing exam.
questions.explanationZh: 考纲写明：COPD 患者主诉呼吸困难时就应该用高流量氧；鼻导管 1–3 L/min 是在（必要时）高流量急性处理之后才用的维持方案。凡是呼吸困难、休克或 CO 中毒的患者都要高流量给氧，滴定到 94%。「低氧驱动」的顾虑不是让急性缺氧患者得不到足够氧的理由；考纲用「先滴定、再降档」来管理这个风险，而不是不给。面罩流量低于 6 L/min 永远不能用。注意课程与考试的差别：AET 术语表教的 COPD 目标是 88–92%；EMALB 考纲是滴定到 94%——执照考试按考纲数字答。

questions.questionEn: Why must an adult oxygen face mask never be run at less than 6 L/min?
questions.questionZh: 为什么成人氧气面罩的流量绝不能低于 6 L/min？

options.en: Below 6 L/min a non-rebreather's reservoir cannot refill between breaths
options.zh: 低于 6 L/min 时非重复呼吸面罩的储气袋来不及在两次呼吸之间充满

options.en: Exhaled CO₂ pools in the mask, so the patient gets less oxygen than room air
options.zh: 呼出的 CO₂ 在面罩内蓄积，患者吸到的氧反而比室内空气还少

options.en: Low flow lets the mask fog and hides cyanosis of the lips
options.zh: 低流量会让面罩起雾，看不见口唇发绀

options.en: Low flow dries the nasal and oral mucosa within minutes
options.zh: 低流量几分钟内就会让鼻腔和口腔黏膜干燥

questions.explanationEn: The BC guideline's own wording is that a flow below 6 L/min through an adult face mask would deliver less oxygen than room air. The mask is a reservoir of the patient's exhaled gas; without enough fresh flow to flush it, the patient rebreathes CO₂-rich, oxygen-poor gas. The reservoir-bag answer describes a different device — the non-rebreather needs 10–15 L/min to keep its bag at least two-thirds full — and the rule applies to a simple face mask with no bag at all. Fogging and mucosal drying are nuisances, not the reason for the rule.
questions.explanationZh: BC 考纲原话：成人面罩流量低于 6 L/min，输送给患者的氧会比室内空气还少。面罩本身是患者呼出气体的储存腔，没有足够的新鲜气流冲洗，患者就会重复吸入富含 CO₂、缺氧的气体。储气袋那个说法描述的是另一种装置——非重复呼吸面罩需要 10–15 L/min 才能让储气袋保持至少三分之二满——而这条规则针对的是根本没有储气袋的简单面罩。起雾和黏膜干燥只是麻烦，不是规则的原因。

questions.questionEn: In the AET course you learn waveform capnography. An asthmatic patient's trace shows a slow, sloping upstroke that never flattens into a plateau, and the EtCO₂ reads 48 mmHg. What does this pattern indicate?
questions.questionZh: AET 课上学过波形二氧化碳监测。一位哮喘患者的波形上升支缓慢倾斜、始终没有形成平台，EtCO₂ 读数 48 mmHg。这个图形提示什么？

options.en: Normal waveform with mild hyperventilation
options.zh: 正常波形，轻度过度通气

options.en: A leak or disconnection in the sampling line
options.zh: 采样管漏气或脱落

options.en: Bronchospasm with air trapping and CO₂ retention
options.zh: 支气管痉挛伴气体潴留和 CO₂ 潴留

options.en: Pulmonary embolism with increased alveolar dead space
options.zh: 肺栓塞伴肺泡死腔增加

questions.explanationEn: Uneven emptying of obstructed alveoli makes the expiratory upstroke slope instead of rising sharply, producing the 'shark fin' shape; it is the signature of bronchospasm (asthma, COPD). An EtCO₂ above the normal 35–45 range means the patient is not clearing CO₂ — a sign of fatigue in an asthmatic. Hyperventilation gives a low EtCO₂ with a normal shape; a leak or disconnection gives a flat line near zero; PE lowers EtCO₂ because of dead space and does not slope the upstroke. Capnography is BCEHS/course content — the EMALB exam guideline does not test waveform shapes, but it does expect you to recognise failing ventilation and assist it.
questions.explanationZh: 阻塞的肺泡排空不均，使呼气上升支变成缓坡而不是陡然上升，形成「鲨鱼鳍」的形状，是支气管痉挛（哮喘、COPD）的标志。EtCO₂ 高于正常的 35–45 范围，说明 CO₂ 排不出去——哮喘患者出现这种情况就是在疲惫。过度通气是 EtCO₂ 低而波形正常；采样管漏气或脱落是接近零的平线；肺栓塞因死腔增加而使 EtCO₂ 降低，不会让上升支倾斜。二氧化碳波形是 BCEHS/课程内容——EMALB 考纲不考波形形状，但要求你识别通气衰竭并辅助通气。

questions.questionEn: A 30-year-old with a suspected opioid overdose is breathing 7 times a minute. On a non-rebreather at 15 L/min his SpO₂ reads 96%, but his EtCO₂ is 62 mmHg and climbing. What is the correct interpretation?
questions.questionZh: 30 岁疑似阿片过量，呼吸 7 次/分。15 L/min 非重复呼吸面罩下 SpO₂ 读 96%，但 EtCO₂ 62 mmHg 且持续上升。正确的解读是什么？

options.en: Oxygenation is adequate, so his ventilation is adequate too
options.zh: 氧合够了，说明通气也够

options.en: The high oxygen flow is inflating the capnograph reading
options.zh: 是高流量氧把二氧化碳读数抬高了

options.en: He is hyperventilating and needs coaching to slow down
options.zh: 他在过度通气，需要引导他放慢呼吸

options.en: He is retaining CO₂ — assist ventilations now
options.zh: 他在潴留 CO₂——现在就辅助通气

questions.explanationEn: Oxygenation and ventilation are separate processes. High-flow oxygen can keep the SpO₂ looking normal for a long time in a patient who is barely breathing, while CO₂ accumulates; the rising EtCO₂ is the earlier, more honest signal. Oxygen flow does not raise an EtCO₂ reading — if anything, a sidestream sampler dilutes it downward — so the number is real. A rate of 7 with a high EtCO₂ is hypoventilation, not hyperventilation. The BC narcotic overdose protocol has ventilation support before naloxone, so assist with the BVM now and then give the drug. Do not let a reassuring pulse-oximeter number talk you out of ventilating.
questions.explanationZh: 氧合和通气是两件事。对一个几乎不呼吸的患者，高流量氧能让 SpO₂ 长时间看起来正常，而 CO₂ 却在不断堆积；上升的 EtCO₂ 才是更早、更诚实的信号。氧流量不会抬高 EtCO₂ 读数——旁流式采样反而会把它稀释得偏低——所以这个数字是真的。呼吸 7 次加上高 EtCO₂ 是通气不足，不是过度通气。BC 的麻醉剂过量规程把支持通气排在纳洛酮之前，所以先 BVM 辅助通气，再给药。别让一个好看的血氧数字劝你放弃通气。

questions.questionEn: Which of these patients needs BVM-assisted ventilation now rather than CPAP?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪位患者现在需要的是 BVM 辅助通气，而不是 CPAP？

options.en: A 68-year-old with COPD, drowsy, RR 7, shallow breaths, SpO₂ 84%
options.zh: 68 岁 COPD 患者，嗜睡，RR 7，呼吸浅，SpO₂ 84%

options.en: A 60-year-old in heart failure, alert, RR 30, SpO₂ 88% on oxygen
options.zh: 60 岁心衰患者，清醒，RR 30，吸氧下 SpO₂ 88%

options.en: A 35-year-old asthmatic, RR 26, following commands, SpO₂ 91% after salbutamol
options.zh: 35 岁哮喘患者，RR 26，能听从指令，沙丁胺醇后 SpO₂ 91%

options.en: A 55-year-old with pneumonia, alert, RR 28, SpO₂ 90%, accessory muscle use
options.zh: 55 岁肺炎患者，清醒，RR 28，SpO₂ 90%，辅助呼吸肌参与

questions.explanationEn: The BC guideline describes imminent or actual respiratory failure as slow respirations, shallow tidal volumes and a falling level of consciousness — and says these patients are not CPAP candidates; they must be ventilated with a BVM and may benefit from PEEP. CPAP only works for someone who can still generate their own breaths against the pressure. The other three are awake, tachypneic and following commands, so they are candidates for CPAP (after bronchodilators where indicated). The AET course frames the same decision as 'is the intervention failing? escalate' — a rising EtCO₂ with a falling rate and new drowsiness is the trigger.
questions.explanationZh: BC 考纲对「即将或已经呼吸衰竭」的描述是：呼吸慢、潮气量浅、意识水平下降——并写明这类患者不是 CPAP 对象，必须 BVM 通气，可能受益于 PEEP。CPAP 只对还能自己对抗压力产生呼吸的人有效。另外三位清醒、呼吸快、能听从指令，是 CPAP 的候选人（有指征时先用支气管扩张剂）。AET 课上把同一个决策讲成「干预是否正在失败？升级」——EtCO₂ 上升、呼吸频率下降、新出现嗜睡就是触发点。

questions.questionEn: After return of spontaneous circulation, your patient is breathing on his own and his SpO₂ reads 100% on 15 L/min by non-rebreather. What is the correct approach to oxygen?
questions.questionZh: 自主循环恢复后，患者能自主呼吸，15 L/min 非重复呼吸面罩下 SpO₂ 读 100%。氧疗该怎么处理？

options.en: Keep 15 L/min running until hospital handover
options.zh: 继续 15 L/min 直到医院交接

options.en: Reduce to a nasal cannula at 2 L/min, accepting an SpO₂ of 88–92%
options.zh: 降为鼻导管 2 L/min，接受 SpO₂ 88–92%

options.en: Titrate down to keep SpO₂ ≥94%, avoiding a sustained 100%
options.zh: 把氧往下调，维持 SpO₂ ≥94%，避免长时间 100%

options.en: Ventilate with a BVM at 20 breaths per minute to wash out acid
options.zh: 用 BVM 以 20 次/分通气来冲洗酸

questions.explanationEn: Every BC protocol titrates oxygen to an SpO₂ of 94% or above rather than to 100%. The AET course adds the reason for the post-ROSC ceiling: a reperfused brain and heart exposed to very high oxygen tensions generate free radicals and more reperfusion injury, so the course target is 94–98%. Running 15 L/min to handover ignores that ceiling. The 88–92% figure is the AET's COPD target and does not apply to a post-arrest patient — it would accept hypoxia in a brain that has just been starved. Hyperventilating a breathing patient lowers cerebral blood flow and venous return; the BC arrest guideline explicitly says to avoid it.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的所有规程都把氧滴定到 SpO₂ 94% 及以上，而不是 100%。AET 课补充了 ROSC 后要封顶的原因：刚恢复灌注的脑和心脏暴露在极高氧分压下会产生自由基、加重再灌注损伤，所以课程目标是 94–98%。一路 15 L/min 到交接就是无视这个上限。88–92% 是 AET 的 COPD 目标，不适用于骤停后的患者——那等于让刚刚缺过血的大脑继续缺氧。对有自主呼吸的患者过度通气会减少脑血流和静脉回流；BC 的骤停指南明确写着要避免。

questions.questionEn: A 40-year-old with a ruptured spleen is pale, tachycardic and confused, yet his pulse oximeter reads 99% on oxygen. Which step of oxygen delivery is failing?
questions.questionZh: 40 岁脾破裂患者面色苍白、心动过速、意识模糊，可吸氧下血氧仪读 99%。氧输送链条的哪一环出了问题？

options.en: Ventilation — splinting from pain limits alveolar air entry
options.zh: 通气——疼痛导致的呼吸受限让肺泡进气不足

options.en: Transport — too little hemoglobin and volume to carry oxygen
options.zh: 运输——血红蛋白和循环血量太少，运不了多少氧

options.en: Diffusion — pulmonary contusion is thickening the alveolar membrane
options.zh: 弥散——肺挫伤让肺泡膜增厚

options.en: Cellular use — mitochondria can no longer take up oxygen
options.zh: 细胞利用——线粒体已经无法摄取氧

questions.explanationEn: Pulse oximetry only reports what fraction of the hemoglobin that is present is saturated. In hemorrhage the lungs are loading each remaining red cell fully (hence 99%), but there are far fewer cells and much less volume reaching the tissues — the transport step of the oxygen cascade fails. A ventilation or diffusion problem would pull the saturation down, and there is no chest injury here to cause a contusion; the mitochondria would use oxygen if it arrived — cellular failure is the picture of cyanide poisoning or late sepsis, not fresh blood loss. The practical lesson is that a normal SpO₂ never rules out shock; treat the hemorrhage (control bleeding, supine, warmth, oxygen, and for the PCP a 20 mL/kg bolus if SBP is under 90 with signs of shock).
questions.explanationZh: 脉搏血氧仪只告诉你现有血红蛋白里有多大比例饱和了氧。大出血时，肺把剩下的每个红细胞都灌满了（所以 99%），但到达组织的红细胞和血量都少得多——氧级联中「运输」这一环失效了。通气或弥散有问题会把饱和度拉低，而且本例没有胸部外伤、不会有肺挫伤；氧要是能送到，线粒体也能用——细胞利用障碍是氰化物中毒或晚期脓毒症的图像，不是新鲜失血的。实际教训是：SpO₂ 正常永远不能排除休克；处理出血本身（止血、平卧、保暖、给氧，PCP 在 SBP 低于 90 且有休克征象时给 20 mL/kg 冲击）。

questions.questionEn: An 80-year-old woke at night gasping. He has bilateral crackles, pink frothy sputum, SpO₂ 85% and BP 168/96, with no chest pain. What is the correct PCP management on scene under the BC CHF/pulmonary edema guideline?
questions.questionZh: 80 岁男性夜间憋醒，双肺湿啰音、粉红色泡沫痰，SpO₂ 85%，BP 168/96，没有胸痛。按 BC 的 CHF/肺水肿指南，PCP 在现场正确的处置是什么？

options.en: Sit him upright, legs dependent; oxygen to SpO₂ ≥94%; consider CPAP on scene
options.zh: 让他坐直、双腿下垂；给氧到 SpO₂ ≥94%；现场考虑 CPAP

options.en: Lay him semi-recumbent and walk him to the stretcher to save time
options.zh: 让他半卧，为省时间让他走到担架上

options.en: Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL every 5 minutes while SBP stays above 110
options.zh: SBP 保持在 110 以上时每 5 分钟舌下含硝酸甘油 0.4 mg

options.en: Salbutamol 5 mg by nebulizer first, because he is wheezing
options.zh: 有哮鸣，先雾化沙丁胺醇 5 mg

questions.explanationEn: The BC guideline for CHF or pulmonary edema: keep the patient at rest and avoid exertion during transfers — bring the lifting equipment to him — position him sitting upright with legs hung down, keep him warm, give oxygen to keep SpO₂ ≥94%, and for the PCP consider CPAP on scene (and a PEEP valve starting at 5 cmH₂O if BVM ventilation is needed). Reclining and walking both worsen pulmonary edema. Nitroglycerin's only indication in the BC monograph is chest discomfort that appears cardiac in nature — the AET glossary mentions pulmonary edema 'in some protocols', but on the licensing exam nitro is not a CHF treatment, however high the blood pressure. Salbutamol treats bronchospasm, not fluid-filled alveoli; 'cardiac wheeze' is fluid, not asthma.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的 CHF/肺水肿指南：让患者休息、搬运时避免用力——把搬运设备搬到他身边——坐直、双腿下垂，保暖，给氧维持 SpO₂ ≥94%，PCP 在现场考虑 CPAP（需要 BVM 通气时 PEEP 阀从 5 cmH₂O 起）。半卧和行走都会加重肺水肿。BC 药物单里硝酸甘油唯一的指征是疑似心源性的胸部不适——AET 术语表提到「部分规程」用于肺水肿，但执照考试里硝酸甘油不是 CHF 的治疗，血压再高也不是。沙丁胺醇治的是支气管痉挛，不是灌满液体的肺泡；「心源性哮鸣」是水，不是哮喘。

questions.questionEn: An adult has a pulse but is breathing 5 times a minute with shallow breaths. At what rate should you ventilate with the BVM?
questions.questionZh: 成人有脉搏，但呼吸 5 次/分且很浅。BVM 通气应该用什么频率？

options.en: One breath every 3 seconds, with a full squeeze of the bag
options.zh: 每 3 秒 1 次，每次把球囊捏到底

options.en: Thirty compressions to two breaths, since a pulse at this rate may be ineffective
options.zh: 30 次按压配 2 次通气，因为这种呼吸频率下的脉搏可能无效

options.en: One breath every 10 seconds, to avoid gastric insufflation
options.zh: 每 10 秒 1 次，避免胃胀气

options.en: One breath every 5–6 seconds, just enough volume for visible chest rise
options.zh: 每 5–6 秒 1 次，潮气量以刚好看到胸廓起伏为度

questions.explanationEn: Rescue breathing for an adult with a pulse is one breath every 5–6 seconds, about 10–12 per minute, with a tidal volume that just produces visible chest rise (roughly 6–8 mL/kg). Every 3 seconds is 20 per minute with a full bag — hyperventilation that raises intrathoracic pressure, cuts venous return and inflates the stomach. Every 10 seconds is only 6 per minute, barely better than his own rate. The 30:2 ratio belongs to CPR on a pulseless patient; compressing someone with a pulse is a 100% deduction on the practical exam. Note that when a PEEP valve is fitted, the BC guideline asks for an even gentler rate — usually no more than 8–10 breaths per minute.
questions.explanationZh: 成人有脉搏时的人工通气是每 5–6 秒 1 次、约 10–12 次/分，潮气量以刚好看到胸廓起伏为度（约 6–8 mL/kg）。每 3 秒 1 次就是 20 次/分还把球囊捏到底——这是过度通气，会升高胸内压、减少静脉回流、把胃吹胀。每 10 秒 1 次只有 6 次/分，比他自己的呼吸好不了多少。30:2 是无脉患者做 CPR 的比例；给有脉搏的人做按压在实操考试里扣 100%。注意：接了 PEEP 阀时，BC 考纲要求更缓的频率——通常不超过 8–10 次/分。

questions.questionEn: Your AED analyses a pulseless adult and advises a shock. Which rhythms is it recognising?
questions.questionZh: AED 分析一位无脉的成人后建议电击。它识别出的是哪些心律？

options.en: Asystole and pulseless electrical activity
options.zh: 心搏停止和无脉性电活动

options.en: Sinus bradycardia and third-degree AV block
options.zh: 窦性心动过缓和三度房室传导阻滞

options.en: Ventricular fibrillation and pulseless ventricular tachycardia
options.zh: 心室颤动和无脉性室性心动过速

options.en: Supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response
options.zh: 室上性心动过速和快速心室率的心房颤动

questions.explanationEn: Only two arrest rhythms respond to defibrillation: VF and pulseless VT, both chaotic or very fast ventricular rhythms that a shock can reset so the SA node can take over. Asystole has no electrical activity to reset, and PEA already has an organised rhythm — the problem there is mechanical or a reversible cause, so both get CPR without a shock. Slow rhythms such as sinus bradycardia or complete heart block are never shocked. SVT and rapid AF with a pulse are not arrest rhythms; if unstable they are treated with synchronised cardioversion, an ALS intervention.
questions.explanationZh: 只有两种骤停心律对除颤有反应：室颤和无脉性室速，都是混乱或极快的室性心律，电击能把它们「重置」，让窦房结重新接管。心搏停止没有电活动可重置；无脉性电活动已经有规整的心律——问题出在机械收缩或可逆病因上，所以两者都是只做 CPR 不电击。窦性心动过缓、完全性传导阻滞这类慢心律永远不电击。有脉搏的室上速和快速房颤不是骤停心律，不稳定时用同步电复律，那是 ALS 的操作。

questions.questionEn: A 52-year-old collapses. The monitor shows regular narrow complexes at 70 per minute, but there is no carotid pulse. What is your management?
questions.questionZh: 52 岁男性倒地。监护仪显示规整的窄 QRS、70 次/分，但摸不到颈动脉搏动。你怎么处理？

options.en: Continue CPR with no shock and work through the H's and T's
options.zh: 持续 CPR、不电击，逐条排查 H's 和 T's

options.en: Deliver a manual shock, since the complexes are organised
options.zh: QRS 规整，手动电击一次

options.en: Stop compressions — electrical activity at 70 means the heart is beating
options.zh: 停止按压——70 次/分的电活动说明心脏在跳

options.en: Synchronised cardioversion at 100 J
options.zh: 100 J 同步电复律

questions.explanationEn: Electrical activity without a pulse is PEA. The heart's wiring is firing, but it is not producing a mechanical output — because the tank is empty (hypovolemia), the lungs are not oxygenating (hypoxia), the chest is under tension, or a toxin, electrolyte or clot is at work. Treatment is uninterrupted high-quality CPR plus a hunt for the cause; no shock is indicated — an AED will say 'no shock advised' — and the BC guideline lists these reversible causes as reasons to consider transport. Cardioversion is for perfusing tachyarrhythmias, not for a pulseless rhythm at 70. Stopping compressions because the screen shows a rhythm is a classic and lethal error: treat the patient, not the monitor.
questions.explanationZh: 有电活动却没有脉搏就是无脉性电活动（PEA）。心脏的「电路」在放电，却没有产生机械输出——可能是容量空了（低血容量）、肺没有氧合（缺氧）、胸腔处于张力状态，或是毒物、电解质、血栓在作怪。处理是不中断的高质量 CPR 加上找病因；不需要电击——AED 会提示「不建议电击」——BC 考纲把这些可逆病因列为考虑转运的理由。电复律是给有灌注的快速心律失常用的，不是给 70 次/分的无脉心律用的。因为屏幕上有心律就停止按压，是经典而致命的错误：看病人，不看监护仪。

questions.questionEn: A 30-year-old was stabbed in the left chest and arrested in front of you. You sealed the wound with an occlusive dressing and started CPR. Now the bag is very hard to squeeze and his neck veins are bulging. Under the BC examination guidelines, what should the PCP do?
questions.questionZh: 30 岁男性左胸被刺，在你面前骤停。你用封闭敷料封住伤口并开始 CPR。现在球囊很难捏动，颈静脉怒张。按 BC 考纲，PCP 该怎么做？

options.en: Needle decompression in the second intercostal space, mid-clavicular line, with a 14-gauge
options.zh: 用 14 号针在第二肋间锁骨中线做针刺减压

options.en: Squeeze the bag harder and add a PEEP valve at 5 cmH₂O
options.zh: 更用力捏球囊，并加上 5 cmH₂O 的 PEEP 阀

options.en: Stop ventilating and continue compressions only
options.zh: 停止通气，只做按压

options.en: Lift the dressing edge to vent the chest, continue CPR, consider transport
options.zh: 掀开敷料一角放气，继续 CPR，考虑转运

questions.explanationEn: A sealed penetrating chest wound can convert an open pneumothorax into a tension pneumothorax; rising ventilation resistance and distended neck veins in a traumatic arrest are the warning. The BC chest trauma guideline says to monitor a sealed wound closely for tension and relieve it if necessary — meaning release the seal — and the arrest guideline lists tension pneumothorax among the reversible causes that justify intra-arrest transport. Needle decompression is taught in the AET course because it is BCEHS practice, but it is not within EMR/PCP scope in the EMALB examination guidelines. Forcing the bag or adding PEEP drives more air into the tensioned chest, and stopping ventilation removes the oxygen the arrest needs.
questions.explanationZh: 穿透性胸部伤口封闭后，开放性气胸可能转为张力性气胸；创伤性骤停中通气阻力上升加颈静脉怒张就是警报。BC 的胸部创伤指南要求封闭后密切观察有无张力性气胸、必要时予以解除——也就是把封闭掀开放气——而骤停指南把张力性气胸列为支持骤停中转运的可逆病因之一。针刺减压在 AET 课上有教，因为那是 BCEHS 的实际做法，但 EMALB 考纲里它不在 EMR/PCP 范围内。更用力捏球囊或加 PEEP 会把更多空气压进已经张力的胸腔，停止通气则拿掉了复苏需要的氧。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old on hemodialysis who missed his last two sessions is found pulseless with a slow, wide-complex rhythm on the monitor. Which reversible cause should be at the top of your list, and what follows?
questions.questionZh: 58 岁血液透析患者，错过了最近两次透析，被发现无脉，监护仪显示缓慢的宽 QRS 心律。最该优先考虑哪个可逆病因，接下来怎么做？

options.en: Hypoglycemia — give D10W 25 g IV during compressions
options.zh: 低血糖——按压期间静脉给 D10W 25 g

options.en: Hyperkalemia — continue CPR and consider early transport
options.zh: 高钾血症——继续 CPR 并考虑尽早转运

options.en: Hypothermia — begin active rewarming on scene
options.zh: 低体温——现场开始主动复温

options.en: Cardiac tamponade — prepare for pericardiocentesis
options.zh: 心包填塞——准备心包穿刺

questions.explanationEn: Missed dialysis lets potassium climb; the ECG progresses from peaked T waves to a widening QRS and finally a sine-wave or slow wide rhythm, then arrest. Hyperkalemia is one of the H's in the BC list of treatable causes, and because its treatment (calcium, insulin-glucose, dialysis) is not available to a PCP, the presence of an apparent reversible cause is the guideline's trigger to consider transport with ongoing CPR. Dextrose during an arrest does nothing for potassium at PCP level and there is no glucose reading to justify it; there is no hypothermia history; and pericardiocentesis is a physician procedure.
questions.explanationZh: 错过透析会让血钾升高；心电图从 T 波高尖进展到 QRS 增宽，最后变成正弦波或缓慢的宽 QRS，继而骤停。高钾血症是 BC 可逆病因清单里的「H」之一，它的治疗（钙剂、胰岛素-葡萄糖、透析）PCP 都给不了，所以「存在明显可逆病因」正是考纲里考虑边 CPR 边转运的触发条件。骤停中推葡萄糖在 PCP 层面对血钾毫无作用，也没有血糖读数支持；病史里没有低体温；心包穿刺是医生的操作。

questions.questionEn: During CPR with waveform capnography (taught in the AET course), the EtCO₂ has been sitting around 30 mmHg. It suddenly jumps to 48 and the patient coughs. What does this most likely mean?
questions.questionZh: CPR 期间接着波形二氧化碳监测（AET 课上教的），EtCO₂ 一直在 30 mmHg 左右。突然跳到 48，患者咳嗽了一下。最可能说明什么？

options.en: Your partner is ventilating too fast
options.zh: 搭档通气太快了

options.en: Compressions have become too deep
options.zh: 按压太深了

options.en: A leak in the sampling line
options.zh: 采样管漏气

options.en: Return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC)
options.zh: 自主循环恢复（ROSC）

questions.explanationEn: EtCO₂ tracks pulmonary blood flow. When the heart restarts, cardiac output rises several-fold and the CO₂ that accumulated in the tissues is delivered to the lungs, producing an abrupt, sustained spike. The BC guideline says pulse checks are done during the analyse pause and when there are signs of ROSC such as spontaneous breaths, coughing, eyelid movement or vocalisation — this patient has one, so check for a pulse at the next rhythm check. Over-ventilation lowers EtCO₂; deeper compressions change it only modestly; a leak drops the reading rather than raising it.
questions.explanationZh: EtCO₂ 反映的是肺血流量。心脏重新跳动时，心排量成倍上升，组织里堆积的 CO₂ 被送到肺部，于是出现突然且持续的尖峰。BC 考纲写明：脉搏检查在分析暂停时做，以及出现 ROSC 迹象（自主呼吸、咳嗽、眼睑活动、发声）时做——这位患者刚好有一项，下一次心律检查时就摸脉搏。过度通气会降低 EtCO₂；按压更深只会让数值小幅变化；采样管漏气会让读数下降而不是上升。

questions.questionEn: Ten minutes into a resuscitation the EtCO₂ has stayed at 8 mmHg. In the AET course's arrest decision pathway, what is the first response to this number?
questions.questionZh: 复苏进行到第 10 分钟，EtCO₂ 一直停在 8 mmHg。按 AET 课的骤停决策路径，看到这个数字首先该做什么？

options.en: Call CliniCall to request termination of resuscitation
options.zh: 打 CliniCall 申请终止复苏

options.en: Increase the oxygen flow to the bag to 25 L/min
options.zh: 把球囊的氧流量调到 25 L/min

options.en: Check compression depth, rate, recoil and ventilation rate
options.zh: 检查按压深度、频率、回弹和通气频率

options.en: Pause compressions for a 12-lead to look for a reversible cause
options.zh: 暂停按压做 12 导联，寻找可逆病因

questions.explanationEn: A persistently low EtCO₂ during CPR means little blood is reaching the lungs — most often because the compressions are shallow, slow, interrupted or being done by a tired rescuer, or because the chest is being over-ventilated. The number is a prompt to fix the CPR and then re-think the reversible causes, not to give up: BCEHS practice (and the AET course) is explicit that EtCO₂ alone is never used to terminate, and a CliniCall consult comes only after quality CPR, rhythm analysis and the causes have all been addressed. More oxygen does not improve blood flow, and a 12-lead during arrest wastes compression time — the reversible causes are found from history and examination, not from a tracing.
questions.explanationZh: CPR 期间 EtCO₂ 持续偏低，说明到达肺部的血流很少——最常见的原因是按压太浅、太慢、被打断、按压者累了，或者通气过度。这个数字是提醒你修正 CPR、再重新审视可逆病因，不是让你放弃：BCEHS 的做法（以及 AET 课）明确规定不能单凭 EtCO₂ 终止复苏，CliniCall 会诊要等高质量 CPR、心律分析和病因都处理过之后才打。调大氧流量改善不了血流，骤停中做 12 导联只会浪费按压时间——可逆病因靠病史和查体找，不靠心电图。

questions.questionEn: According to the BC examination guidelines, at which point during a cardiac arrest must a PCP consult medical oversight?
questions.questionZh: 按 BC 考纲，心搏骤停过程中 PCP 在哪个时点必须咨询医疗监督？

options.en: Only before discontinuing resuscitation on scene
options.zh: 只有在现场终止复苏之前

options.en: Before the third and any later defibrillation
options.zh: 第三次及之后的每次除颤前

options.en: Before inserting a supraglottic airway in a traumatic arrest
options.zh: 创伤性骤停中置入声门上气道前

options.en: Before giving naloxone for a suspected opioid arrest
options.zh: 疑似阿片类骤停给纳洛酮前

questions.explanationEn: The guideline's arrest section has a single heading 'When to consult with medical oversight during a cardiac arrest', and the only item under it is discontinuing the arrest at the scene; the 2026 change index records that all other medical-oversight requirements were removed. Defibrillation follows the AED prompts however many shocks it takes, the SGA may be inserted by a PCP once high-quality arrest management is under way regardless of cause, and naloxone has no consult requirement. The AET course teaches the BCEHS version — a CliniCall consult — and before making that call you must have confirmed high-quality CPR, rhythm analysis with any indicated shocks, and that reversible causes were addressed.
questions.explanationZh: 考纲骤停章节只有一个标题「心搏骤停中何时咨询医疗监督」，下面唯一的一条就是在现场终止复苏；2026 年的修订索引记录了其他所有医疗监督要求都已删除。除颤跟着 AED 的提示走，电几次都不用请示；PCP 在高质量骤停处置启动后即可置入声门上气道，与病因无关；纳洛酮也没有咨询要求。AET 课教的是 BCEHS 版本——打 CliniCall 会诊——打电话之前必须已确认做了高质量 CPR、完成了心律分析和该给的电击、处理了可逆病因。

questions.questionEn: A 78-year-old was found unresponsive at home. You have done 25 minutes of CPR, the AED has never advised a shock, and there has been no ROSC. Under the BC examination guidelines, what is correct?
questions.questionZh: 78 岁老人在家中被发现无反应。你们已做了 25 分钟 CPR，AED 从未建议电击，也没有 ROSC。按 BC 考纲，哪项正确？

options.en: Stop now — 20 minutes without ROSC is the limit for an unwitnessed arrest
options.zh: 现在就停——无目击骤停没有 ROSC 的上限是 20 分钟

options.en: Continue to 30 minutes, consulting medical oversight before stopping
options.zh: 继续做到 30 分钟，停止前咨询医疗监督

options.en: Continue to 40 minutes, because no shock has been delivered
options.zh: 因为没电击过，要做到 40 分钟

options.en: Continue CPR and transport, because home arrests cannot be discontinued
options.zh: 继续 CPR 并转运，因为家中骤停不能就地终止

questions.explanationEn: The BC adult CPR/AED algorithm lists the stopping points: care is transferred to more advanced providers, there are signs of life, 30 minutes have elapsed with no ROSC and no defibrillations, or 40 minutes if there was ROSC at any time or any defibrillation was delivered. This patient has had neither ROSC nor a shock, so the relevant figure is 30 minutes — there is no 20-minute rule — and discontinuing on scene is the one decision that requires a medical oversight consult. The 40-minute window is for patients who did receive a shock or regained a pulse at some point, the opposite of this case. Location does not force transport: a non-shockable arrest with no reversible cause is managed, and may be discontinued, where the patient lies.
questions.explanationZh: BC 成人 CPR/AED 流程列出的停止条件：交给更高级别的医疗人员、出现生命迹象、30 分钟无 ROSC 且未除颤，或者曾有 ROSC 或曾除颤则为 40 分钟。这位患者既没有 ROSC 也没有电击过，适用的是 30 分钟——不存在 20 分钟的规则——而现场终止是唯一需要咨询医疗监督的决定。40 分钟的窗口是给电击过或曾恢复过脉搏的患者，和本例正好相反。地点并不强制转运：没有可逆病因的不可电击骤停，就在患者倒下的地方处理，也可以在那里终止。

questions.questionEn: A 55-year-old's witnessed arrest was shocked twice in the first five minutes but remains in VF. You are now at 32 minutes with no ROSC. What does the BC guideline say?
questions.questionZh: 55 岁目击骤停，前 5 分钟内电击了两次，但仍是室颤。现在到了第 32 分钟，没有 ROSC。BC 考纲怎么说？

options.en: Stop — the 30-minute limit has passed without ROSC
options.zh: 停止——30 分钟上限已过且无 ROSC

options.en: Load and transport now, with no further shocks en route
options.zh: 现在装车转运，途中不再电击

options.en: Continue — the shocks extend the time frame to 40 minutes
options.zh: 继续——电击过，时限延长到 40 分钟

options.en: Stop — VF persisting after two shocks is considered refractory
options.zh: 停止——两次电击后仍持续的室颤视为难治性

questions.explanationEn: The guideline's 40-minute rule applies if there was ROSC at any time or if defibrillations were delivered — and a shockable rhythm is the arrest with the best outlook, so effort is extended, not shortened. Each analysis cycle continues: shock if advised, two minutes of CPR, analyse again; there is no 'two strikes' rule that declares VF refractory. Transport decisions during arrest are driven by reversible causes, paediatrics, hypothermia or trauma, not by the clock alone, CPR quality drops sharply during movement, and you would never stop shocking a shockable rhythm.
questions.explanationZh: 考纲的 40 分钟规则适用于曾经出现 ROSC 或做过除颤的情况——可电击心律是预后最好的骤停，所以努力的时间要延长而不是缩短。每个分析周期照常进行：建议电击就电击，再做 2 分钟 CPR，再分析；不存在「两次不成就算难治」的规则。骤停中的转运决定取决于可逆病因、儿科、低体温或创伤，而不是单纯看时间；搬动过程中 CPR 质量会明显下降，而且对可电击心律永远不能停止电击。

questions.questionEn: Which of these arrest patients is a candidate for transport with CPR in progress under the BC examination guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 按 BC 考纲，下列哪位骤停患者适合边做 CPR 边转运？

options.en: A 75-year-old found in asystole at home with no identifiable cause
options.zh: 75 岁在家中被发现心搏停止，找不到病因

options.en: An 82-year-old with a valid, verified No CPR order
options.zh: 82 岁，有有效且已核实的「不做 CPR」医嘱

options.en: A 55-year-old in asystole for 25 minutes with no cause found
options.zh: 55 岁心搏停止 25 分钟，未找到病因

options.en: A 6-year-old pulled from a cold lake, now pulseless
options.zh: 6 岁从冰冷的湖里被救出，现在无脉

questions.explanationEn: The guideline permits intra-arrest transport with ongoing CPR for paediatric, hypothermic and traumatic arrests and for apparent treatable causes. The drowned child qualifies three times over: paediatric, cold-water hypothermia, and hypoxia as the reversible cause. Remember the asphyxial-arrest rule for this patient too — if alone, give about two minutes of CPR before applying the AED. The elderly asystolic patients with no reversible cause are managed on scene (CPR is more effective when stationary), and a valid No CPR order is a contraindication to starting resuscitation at all.
questions.explanationZh: 考纲允许在儿科、低体温、创伤性骤停以及存在明显可治疗病因时边 CPR 边转运。溺水的孩子三条都占：儿科、冷水低体温、以缺氧为可逆病因。对这位患者还要记住窒息性骤停的规则——如果只有你一人，先做约 2 分钟 CPR 再贴 AED。没有可逆病因的老年心搏停止患者在现场处理（静止状态下 CPR 更有效），而有效的「不做 CPR」医嘱是根本不启动复苏的禁忌。

questions.questionEn: Which set of targets describes high-quality adult CPR under the BC guideline?
questions.questionZh: 哪一组指标符合 BC 考纲对高质量成人 CPR 的要求？

options.en: 80–100 per minute, 4–5 cm, 10-second pulse checks every cycle
options.zh: 80–100 次/分，4–5 cm，每个周期查脉 10 秒

options.en: 100–120 per minute, 5–6 cm, interruptions under 5 seconds
120–140 per minute, 6–7 cm, ventilate 20 times a minute
options.zh: 120–140 次/分，6–7 cm，每分钟通气 20 次

options.en: 100 per minute, 5 cm, continue compressing during AED analysis
options.zh: 100 次/分，5 cm，AED 分析时继续按压

questions.explanationEn: BC: compress at 100–120 per minute to a depth of 5.0–6.0 cm in a normal adult (one-third to one-half of chest diameter for smaller or larger patients), allow complete recoil, keep interruptions under 5 seconds, switch compressors every 2 minutes to prevent fatigue, and avoid hyperventilation. Pulse checks happen during the analyse pause, so a 10-second pulse check every cycle erodes the compression fraction. Faster than 120 or deeper than 6 cm causes injury and incomplete recoil, and 20 ventilations a minute is hyperventilation. Compressing during analysis corrupts the AED's reading.
questions.explanationZh: BC：成人按压频率 100–120 次/分，深度 5.0–6.0 cm（体型偏小或偏大者按胸廓前后径的 1/3 到 1/2），让胸廓完全回弹，中断少于 5 秒，每 2 分钟换人防止疲劳，避免过度通气。脉搏检查在分析暂停时进行，所以每个周期查脉 10 秒会拉低按压比例。快于 120 或深于 6 cm 会造成损伤和回弹不全，每分钟通气 20 次是过度通气。分析时按压会干扰 AED 判读。

questions.questionEn: You are alone when you find a hanging victim who has been cut down. He has no pulse and your AED is in your bag. What does the BC guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 你独自一人，发现一名已被解下的上吊者，无脉搏，AED 在你包里。BC 考纲怎么要求？

options.en: Five cycles (about 2 minutes) of CPR before applying the AED
options.zh: 先做 5 个周期（约 2 分钟）CPR，再贴 AED

options.en: Apply the AED and analyse before starting compressions
options.zh: 先贴 AED 分析，再开始按压

options.en: Two minutes of rescue breaths before compressions, since the cause is hypoxic
options.zh: 因为病因是缺氧，先做 2 分钟人工呼吸再按压

options.en: Compressions only, no ventilations, until your partner arrives
options.zh: 只按压不通气，直到搭档到达

questions.explanationEn: Hanging, overdose, choking, smoke inhalation and drowning cause asphyxial arrests — the heart stopped because of hypoxia, not a primary rhythm problem. The BC guideline says that if you are alone with an AED, give five cycles of CPR (about 2 minutes) before applying it; with two rescuers, one applies the AED while the other does CPR for those five cycles, then analyse. Oxygenating the patient first improves the chance that any shock will work. Breaths without compressions move no blood, and compressions without breaths leave an asphyxiated patient with nothing to circulate — the 30:2 cycles give both. Waiting for help abandons the patient.
questions.explanationZh: 上吊、过量、噎住、烟雾吸入和溺水造成的是窒息性骤停——心脏是因为缺氧而停，不是原发的心律问题。BC 考纲规定：独自一人且有 AED 时，先做 5 个周期（约 2 分钟）CPR 再贴；两名施救者时，一人贴 AED、另一人做这 5 个周期 CPR，然后再分析。先给患者氧合，能提高之后电击成功的机会。只吹气不按压推不动血，只按压不吹气则让窒息的患者无氧可循环——30:2 的周期两者兼顾。等人来相当于放弃患者。

questions.questionEn: A 76-year-old with a failing left ventricle is coughing up pink, frothy sputum and is profoundly hypoxic. What is the mechanism that is blocking oxygen from reaching her blood?
questions.questionZh: 76 岁女性左心室功能衰竭，咳粉红色泡沫痰，严重缺氧。阻碍氧进入血液的机制是什么？

options.en: Bronchospasm narrows the small airways and traps air
options.zh: 支气管痉挛让小气道变窄、气体潴留

options.en: Bacterial infection fills the alveoli with purulent exudate
options.zh: 细菌感染让肺泡充满脓性渗出物

options.en: Surfactant loss collapses the alveoli, as in ARDS
options.zh: 表面活性物质丢失导致肺泡塌陷，如同 ARDS

options.en: Capillary hydrostatic pressure forces plasma into the alveoli
options.zh: 毛细血管静水压把血浆挤进肺泡

questions.explanationEn: When the left ventricle cannot empty, pressure backs up through the left atrium into the pulmonary veins and capillaries. Once capillary hydrostatic pressure exceeds the pressure holding fluid in the vessels, plasma leaks into the interstitium and then into the alveoli — fluid that oxygen has to diffuse through, and that is coughed up pink from the small amount of blood mixed in. This is why the treatment is to sit the patient up, give oxygen and apply CPAP: positive pressure pushes the fluid back and re-opens flooded alveoli. Bronchospasm and infection are different diseases, and surfactant loss is the mechanism of ARDS and prematurity, not heart failure.
questions.explanationZh: 左心室排不出血时，压力经左心房倒灌到肺静脉和肺毛细血管。一旦毛细血管静水压超过把液体留在血管内的压力，血浆就渗到间质、再进入肺泡——氧必须穿过这层液体才能弥散，而混进少量血的液体咳出来就是粉红色。这就是治疗要让患者坐起、给氧、上 CPAP 的原因：正压把液体推回去，重新打开被淹没的肺泡。支气管痉挛和感染是另外的病；表面活性物质丢失是 ARDS 和早产儿的机制，不是心衰的。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old has crushing chest pain, SBP 84, HR 110, cool clammy skin, bilateral crackles and SpO₂ 90%. Which option is correct for the PCP under the BC examination guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 68 岁男性压榨性胸痛，SBP 84，HR 110，皮肤湿冷，双肺湿啰音，SpO₂ 90%。按 BC 考纲，PCP 的哪项处置正确？

options.en: ASA and nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL, since the pain is clearly cardiac in origin
options.zh: ASA 加舌下硝酸甘油 0.4 mg，因为疼痛明显是心源性的

options.en: Normal saline 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L, reassessing every 500 mL
options.zh: 生理盐水 20 mL/kg，最多 2 L，每 500 mL 复评

options.en: ASA, oxygen, upright, rapid transport with ALS — no nitroglycerin
options.zh: ASA、给氧、坐起、快速转运并请 ALS——不给硝酸甘油

options.en: CPAP at 5 cmH₂O for the pulmonary edema, titrating to 10 cmH₂O
options.zh: 为肺水肿上 5 cmH₂O 的 CPAP，逐步调到 10 cmH₂O

questions.explanationEn: This is cardiogenic shock: the pump is failing, so the lungs are wet and the pressure is low. ASA still applies — it is the one drug that needs no vital signs first, and its contraindications are about bleeding and allergy, not blood pressure. Nitroglycerin is contraindicated with SBP below 110 whatever the cause of the pain; a venodilator here could stop his heart. A fluid bolus is for hypovolemia and requires evidence of volume loss — these lungs are already flooded. CPAP is contraindicated with SBP under 90 and would further cut venous return. What he needs is oxygen to SpO₂ ≥94%, positioning, no preload-dropping drugs, and the fastest route to ALS and a cath lab.
questions.explanationZh: 这是心源性休克：泵失灵了，所以肺里有水、血压却低。ASA 仍然适用——它是唯一不需要先测生命体征的药，禁忌是出血和过敏，和血压无关。硝酸甘油在 SBP 低于 110 时禁用，不管胸痛是什么原因；此时扩静脉可能直接让心脏停跳。液体冲击是给低血容量用的，要求有容量丢失的证据——这双肺已经泡在水里了。CPAP 在 SBP 低于 90 时禁用，还会进一步减少静脉回流。他需要的是给氧到 SpO₂ ≥94%、体位、不用任何降前负荷的药，以及最快到达 ALS 和导管室的路。

questions.questionEn: A 54-year-old with chest pressure has 3 mm of ST elevation in V2, V3 and V4, with ST depression in II, III and aVF. Where is the infarct and which artery is most likely occluded?
questions.questionZh: 54 岁男性胸部压迫感，V2、V3、V4 导联 ST 抬高 3 mm，II、III、aVF 导联 ST 压低。梗死在哪个壁、最可能是哪条血管闭塞？

options.en: Inferior wall — right coronary artery
options.zh: 下壁——右冠状动脉

options.en: Lateral wall — left circumflex artery
options.zh: 侧壁——左回旋支

options.en: Posterior wall — right coronary or circumflex, confirm with V7–V9
options.zh: 后壁——右冠或回旋支，需 V7–V9 确认

options.en: Anterior wall — left anterior descending artery
options.zh: 前壁——左前降支

questions.explanationEn: V1–V4 look at the anterior wall, supplied by the left anterior descending artery; elevation of at least 2 mm in two or more contiguous precordial leads meets the STEMI threshold, and the depression in the inferior leads is the mirror image that confirms a true infarct rather than pericarditis or early repolarisation. Inferior infarcts elevate II, III and aVF — here those leads are depressed, not elevated; lateral ones elevate I, aVL, V5–V6; a posterior infarct shows tall R waves and ST depression in V1–V3, not elevation. Anterior STEMIs involve the most muscle, so transmit the 12-lead and pre-notify the PCI centre early.
questions.explanationZh: V1–V4 看的是前壁，由左前降支供血；两个以上相邻胸前导联 ST 抬高至少 2 mm 达到 STEMI 标准，而下壁导联的压低是镜像改变，证实这是真正的梗死而不是心包炎或早期复极。下壁梗死抬高的是 II、III、aVF——本例这几个导联是压低而不是抬高；侧壁是 I、aVL、V5–V6；后壁梗死在 V1–V3 表现为高 R 波和 ST 压低，而不是抬高。前壁 STEMI 累及的心肌最多，所以要尽早传输 12 导联并预先通知 PCI 中心。

questions.questionEn: A 60-year-old with ongoing chest pain has a 12-lead showing tall, broad R waves in V1–V2 with 2 mm of ST depression in V1–V3 and upright T waves there. No lead shows ST elevation. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 60 岁男性持续胸痛，12 导联显示 V1–V2 高而宽的 R 波、V1–V3 ST 压低 2 mm 且 T 波直立，没有任何导联 ST 抬高。你该怎么办？

options.en: Normal variant — tall R waves in V1 are common in young men
options.zh: 正常变异——V1 高 R 波在年轻男性中很常见

options.en: Suspect posterior STEMI — acquire V7–V9 and manage as a STEMI
options.zh: 怀疑后壁 STEMI——加做 V7–V9，按 STEMI 处理

options.en: Anterior subendocardial ischemia — treat along the NSTEMI pathway
options.zh: 前壁心内膜下缺血——按 NSTEMI 路径处理

options.en: Lead misplacement — repeat the 12-lead after re-checking V1 and V2
options.zh: 导联贴错——核对 V1、V2 位置后复查 12 导联

questions.explanationEn: V1–V3 face the anterior wall, so they see the back of the heart in reverse: a posterior infarct's ST elevation appears as ST depression, its Q waves appear as tall R waves, and its inverted T waves appear upright. The AET course lists this pattern among the STEMI equivalents. Confirm it by placing V7–V9 on the posterior chest, where even 0.5 mm of elevation is diagnostic — but do not delay care for it: the chest pain protocol (ASA, nitroglycerin if criteria are met, oxygen for SpO₂ below 94%, rapid transport) applies either way, and the receiving hospital needs early notice that a posterior STEMI is coming. A 60-year-old with ongoing pain is not a 'normal variant', calling it NSTEMI misses an occluded artery that needs PCI now, and a misplacement check must never replace treating the pattern in front of you.
questions.explanationZh: V1–V3 正对前壁，所以它们看到的是心脏后壁的反像：后壁梗死的 ST 抬高表现为 ST 压低，Q 波表现为高 R 波，倒置的 T 波表现为直立。AET 课把这个图形列入 STEMI 等同征象。把 V7–V9 贴在后胸确认——那里哪怕 0.5 mm 的抬高都有诊断意义——但别为此耽误处置：胸痛规程（ASA、符合条件时硝酸甘油、SpO₂ 低于 94% 时给氧、快速转运）无论如何都适用，而接收医院需要提前知道来的是一例后壁 STEMI。60 岁、持续胸痛的人不是「正常变异」；判成 NSTEMI 会漏掉一条现在就需要 PCI 的闭塞血管；核对导联位置永远不能代替处理眼前的图形。

questions.questionEn: A 71-year-old diabetic has 40 minutes of chest heaviness and nausea. Her 12-lead shows a QRS of 0.14 s with a deep S in V1 and a broad notched R in V6; her last ECG, which she carries in her purse, was normal. How should this be treated?
questions.questionZh: 71 岁糖尿病女性，胸闷、恶心 40 分钟。12 导联 QRS 0.14 秒，V1 深 S 波，V6 宽而有切迹的 R 波；她随身带着的上一次心电图是正常的。该怎么处理？

options.en: As a STEMI equivalent — chest pain protocol and a PCI-capable destination
options.zh: 按 STEMI 等同处理——胸痛规程，送有 PCI 能力的医院

options.en: As a chronic bundle branch block — routine chest pain protocol to the closest ED
options.zh: 按慢性束支阻滞——常规胸痛规程送最近的急诊

options.en: As unstable ventricular tachycardia — synchronised cardioversion
options.zh: 按不稳定室速——同步电复律

options.en: As a non-cardiac cause — withhold ASA until the hospital confirms
options.zh: 按非心源性——等医院确诊再给 ASA

questions.explanationEn: A QRS of 0.12 s or more with a deep S in V1 and a broad, notched R in the lateral leads is left bundle branch block. LBBB distorts the ST segments so a conventional STEMI cannot be read, and a block that is new in a patient with ischemic symptoms is itself treated as a STEMI equivalent — the AET course teaches this alongside the Sgarbossa criteria. Her old tracing proves the block is new, which is exactly what separates this from a chronic LBBB that could go to the closest ED. Prehospital care does not change: ASA (no vitals needed), nitroglycerin only if SBP is 110 or above and the other contraindications are excluded, oxygen to SpO₂ ≥94%, and the earliest possible warning to a PCI centre. Cardioversion is for unstable tachyarrhythmias with a pulse; this is a conduction pattern at a normal rate.
questions.explanationZh: QRS ≥0.12 秒、V1 深 S 波、侧壁导联宽而有切迹的 R 波，就是左束支传导阻滞。LBBB 会扭曲 ST 段，让常规的 STEMI 判读失效；而缺血症状患者的新发阻滞本身就按 STEMI 等同处理——AET 课把它和 Sgarbossa 标准一起教。她的旧心电图证明这个阻滞是新发的，这正是它和「可以送最近急诊的慢性 LBBB」的区别。院前处置并不改变：ASA（不需要先测生命体征）、SBP ≥110 且排除其他禁忌时才给硝酸甘油、给氧到 SpO₂ ≥94%，并尽早通知 PCI 中心。电复律是给有脉搏且不稳定的快速心律失常用的；这是频率正常的传导图形。

questions.questionEn: In the AET module on point-of-care diagnostics, a venous blood gas from a 29-year-old with deep, rapid breathing and a glucometer reading of 'HI' shows pH 7.22, pCO₂ 28 mmHg, HCO₃⁻ 12 mmol/L. What is the acid–base disturbance?
questions.questionZh: AET 床旁诊断模块里，一位 29 岁、呼吸深快、血糖仪显示「HI」的患者，静脉血气 pH 7.22、pCO₂ 28 mmHg、HCO₃⁻ 12 mmol/L。这是什么酸碱紊乱？

options.en: Respiratory acidosis from hypoventilation
options.zh: 通气不足引起的呼吸性酸中毒

options.en: Respiratory alkalosis from hyperventilation
options.zh: 过度通气引起的呼吸性碱中毒

options.en: Metabolic acidosis with respiratory compensation
options.zh: 代谢性酸中毒伴呼吸代偿

options.en: Metabolic alkalosis from vomiting
options.zh: 呕吐引起的代谢性碱中毒

questions.explanationEn: Start with the pH: 7.22 is acidotic, so both alkalosis answers are out. Then ask which value explains it. Bicarbonate is far below the normal 22–26, so the primary problem is metabolic — ketoacids are consuming the buffer: this is the picture of diabetic ketoacidosis. The low pCO₂ (normal 35–45) is not the cause; it is the lungs compensating by blowing off CO₂, which is exactly what the Kussmaul breathing you can see at the bedside is doing. A respiratory acidosis would show a high pCO₂. Blood gases are hospital and BCEHS content; on the licensing exam the field equivalents are the glucometer, the respiratory pattern and the fruity breath.
questions.explanationZh: 先看 pH：7.22 是酸中毒，两个碱中毒的选项直接排除。再问是哪个指标造成的。碳酸氢根远低于正常的 22–26，所以原发问题是代谢性的——酮酸在消耗缓冲碱：这就是糖尿病酮症酸中毒的图像。偏低的 pCO₂（正常 35–45）不是病因，而是肺在代偿、把 CO₂ 吹掉，这正是你在床边看到的 Kussmaul 呼吸在做的事。呼吸性酸中毒的 pCO₂ 应该高。血气是医院和 BCEHS 的内容；执照考试里对应的现场依据是血糖仪、呼吸模式和烂苹果味的呼气。

questions.questionEn: You are transferring a 66-year-old woman from a rural clinic. The nurse hands you a result: high-sensitivity troponin clearly elevated. Her 12-lead shows only flattened T waves, and she still has jaw pain. Which plan is correct?
questions.questionZh: 你从一家乡村诊所转运一位 66 岁女性。护士递给你一份结果：高敏肌钙蛋白明显升高。她的 12 导联只有 T 波低平，下颌仍在疼。哪个方案正确？

options.en: Troponin without ST elevation is non-specific — routine transfer to the nearest ED
options.zh: 没有 ST 抬高的肌钙蛋白升高不具特异性——常规转运到最近的急诊

options.en: Treat as NSTEMI — chest pain protocol, serial 12-leads, a cardiology-capable destination
options.zh: 按 NSTEMI 处理——胸痛规程、连续复查 12 导联、送有心内科能力的医院

options.en: Activate a STEMI bypass directly to the catheterisation lab
options.zh: 启动 STEMI 绕行，直接送导管室

options.en: Treat as unstable angina — nitroglycerin only, withholding ASA until the diagnosis is confirmed
options.zh: 按不稳定型心绞痛——只给硝酸甘油，等确诊再给 ASA

questions.explanationEn: A raised troponin with ischemic symptoms but no ST elevation is a non-ST-elevation MI: the artery is critically narrowed rather than fully blocked, and the patient is still at high risk of occluding completely — so this is not a routine transfer to whichever ED is closest. Prehospital treatment follows the chest pain protocol (ASA, nitroglycerin if SBP ≥110 and no other contraindication, oxygen for SpO₂ below 94%), with ongoing monitoring and repeat 12-leads because an NSTEMI can evolve into a STEMI on the way. STEMI bypass is reserved for ST elevation or an equivalent. Withholding ASA is backwards: a troponin rise means myocardium is already dying, and ASA needs no confirmation and no vitals. The AET course frames this as recognise → interpret → act: the diagnostic result changes the destination decision, not the protocol.
questions.explanationZh: 有缺血症状、肌钙蛋白升高却没有 ST 抬高，就是非 ST 抬高型心梗：血管是严重狭窄而不是完全闭塞，患者仍有很高的完全闭塞风险——所以这不是「哪家急诊近送哪家」的常规转运。院前处置按胸痛规程（ASA、SBP ≥110 且无其他禁忌时硝酸甘油、SpO₂ 低于 94% 时给氧），持续监护并复查 12 导联，因为 NSTEMI 在路上可能演变成 STEMI。STEMI 绕行只给 ST 抬高或等同征象。不给 ASA 是弄反了：肌钙蛋白升高说明心肌已经在坏死，而 ASA 既不需要确诊也不需要先测生命体征。AET 课把这类情形讲成「识别→解读→行动」：诊断结果改变的是目的地决策，不是规程本身。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old with a urinary infection has HR 112, BP 118/70, RR 22 and feels 'washed out'. A point-of-care lactate (AET/BCEHS content) is 4.5 mmol/L. What does the lactate tell you?
questions.questionZh: 70 岁男性尿路感染，HR 112，BP 118/70，RR 22，自觉「虚脱」。床旁乳酸（AET/BCEHS 内容）4.5 mmol/L。这个乳酸值说明什么？

options.en: Dehydration from the fever — oral rehydration will correct it
options.zh: 发热引起的脱水——口服补液就能纠正

options.en: Stress hyperglycemia driven by the infection
options.zh: 感染引起的应激性高血糖

options.en: Hyperventilation from the fever — lactate rises with respiratory alkalosis
options.zh: 发热引起的过度通气——呼吸性碱中毒时乳酸会升高

options.en: Occult shock — tissues are hypoperfused despite a normal BP
options.zh: 隐匿性休克——血压虽正常，组织已灌注不足

questions.explanationEn: Lactate rises when cells cannot get enough oxygen and switch to anaerobic metabolism; a level above 4 mmol/L is strongly associated with sepsis mortality. The key teaching point is that hypotension is a late sign: this man's vasoconstriction is holding his blood pressure up while his organs are already starving — the tachycardia and tachypnea are the compensation you can see without a lab. Simple dehydration does not push lactate above 4, lactate is not a glucose measurement, and mild hyperventilation does not produce this degree of acid. The field response is oxygen, vascular access, fluids for hypotension under the PCP protocols, rapid transport and a pre-notification that describes a suspected septic patient. Lactate measurement is not in the EMALB guidelines; recognising compensated shock from vital signs is.
questions.explanationZh: 细胞得不到足够的氧、转为无氧代谢时乳酸就会升高；超过 4 mmol/L 与脓毒症死亡率高度相关。核心教学点是：低血压是晚期征象——这位患者靠血管收缩撑住了血压，器官却已经在挨饿，心动过速和呼吸增快就是不用化验也能看见的代偿。单纯脱水不会把乳酸推到 4 以上，乳酸也不是血糖，轻度过度通气产生不了这么多酸。现场的应对是给氧、建立血管通路、按 PCP 规程对低血压补液、快速转运，并在预通知里说明是疑似脓毒症患者。乳酸测定不在 EMALB 考纲里；凭生命体征识别代偿期休克则在。

questions.questionEn: In the AET module, a point-of-care ultrasound clip from a fall patient shows no lung sliding on the right and a 'barcode' (stratosphere) pattern on M-mode; the left side slides normally. What is the finding?
questions.questionZh: AET 模块里，一位坠落伤患者的床旁超声片段显示右侧没有肺滑动征、M 型超声呈「条形码」（平流层）图形；左侧滑动正常。这是什么发现？

options.en: A right-sided pneumothorax
options.zh: 右侧气胸

options.en: Pulmonary edema on the right
options.zh: 右侧肺水肿

options.en: A right pleural effusion
options.zh: 右侧胸腔积液

options.en: Normal lung on both sides
options.zh: 双侧肺正常

questions.explanationEn: Normal lung shows the visceral pleura sliding against the parietal pleura with each breath; on M-mode that produces the sandy 'seashore' pattern. When air separates the two layers, the sliding disappears and M-mode shows only horizontal lines — the barcode or stratosphere sign. Pulmonary edema produces vertical B-lines with sliding preserved, and an effusion shows as a black fluid stripe above the diaphragm. Ultrasound is a physician and ALS tool shown in the course for awareness; the PCP's exam-level job is the clinical one — oxygen, watch for the signs of tension (rising ventilation pressure, distended neck veins, hypotension), and treat chest trauma per the BC guideline.
questions.explanationZh: 正常肺在每次呼吸时脏层胸膜贴着壁层胸膜滑动，M 型超声呈现沙滩状的「海岸征」。空气把两层分开后，滑动消失，M 型超声只剩水平线——条形码或平流层征。肺水肿产生垂直的 B 线且滑动保留，胸腔积液表现为膈肌上方的黑色液体带。超声是医生和 ALS 的工具，课程展示它是为了拓宽认识；PCP 考试层面的任务是临床的——给氧，警惕张力性气胸的征象（通气压力升高、颈静脉怒张、低血压），并按 BC 指南处理胸部创伤。

questions.questionEn: Three people rescued from a house fire all have headache and nausea. Each has a pulse oximeter reading of 98–99% on room air. What is the correct oxygen decision?
questions.questionZh: 三名从房屋火灾中救出的人都有头痛、恶心。每人室内空气下的血氧仪读数都是 98–99%。氧疗该怎么决定？

options.en: No oxygen — saturations above 94% do not need it
options.zh: 不给氧——饱和度高于 94% 不需要

options.en: Nasal cannula at 2 L/min, titrated to keep SpO₂ at 94% as the guideline states
options.zh: 鼻导管 2 L/min，按考纲滴定维持 SpO₂ 94%

options.en: Non-rebreather at 15 L/min for all three, regardless of SpO₂
options.zh: 三人都用 15 L/min 非重复呼吸面罩，不管 SpO₂ 多少

options.en: Salbutamol 5 mg by nebulizer for smoke-irritated airways
options.zh: 烟雾刺激气道，雾化沙丁胺醇 5 mg

questions.explanationEn: Carbon monoxide binds hemoglobin about 200 times more avidly than oxygen and the resulting carboxyhemoglobin reflects light almost exactly like oxyhemoglobin, so a conventional two-wavelength pulse oximeter reads falsely normal — which is why the usual 'titrate to 94%' rule is suspended here. The BC oxygen guideline is explicit that a non-rebreather is indicated for CO poisoning and smoke inhalation, and that CO poisoning calls for high-flow oxygen irrespective of the saturation — oxygen is the antidote, shortening the half-life of carboxyhemoglobin. The AET course adds that every patient from an enclosed-space fire should have CO-oximetry. A low-flow cannula or a bronchodilator does not address the poisoning.
questions.explanationZh: 一氧化碳与血红蛋白的亲和力约是氧的 200 倍，生成的碳氧血红蛋白对光的反射几乎和氧合血红蛋白一样，所以常规的双波长血氧仪会读出假性正常——这正是「滴定到 94%」的常规在这里失效的原因。BC 氧疗指南明确写着：CO 中毒和烟雾吸入要用非重复呼吸面罩，CO 中毒不论饱和度多少都要高流量给氧——氧就是解毒剂，能缩短碳氧血红蛋白的半衰期。AET 课补充：密闭空间火灾救出的每位患者都应做 CO 血氧测定。低流量鼻导管或支气管扩张剂都解决不了中毒本身。

questions.questionEn: An 80-year-old is unresponsive and sweaty. Your glucometer displays 'LO'. How do you interpret and act on it?
questions.questionZh: 80 岁老人无反应、出汗。血糖仪显示「LO」。怎么解读、怎么处理？

options.en: Meter error — skip the glucose check and move on
options.zh: 仪器出错——跳过血糖检查继续

options.en: A low-normal value — no treatment is needed
options.zh: 正常偏低——不需要处理

options.en: Hyperglycemia — the display overflowed above 27.8 mmol/L
options.zh: 高血糖——读数超过 27.8 mmol/L 溢出了

options.en: Severe hypoglycemia — D10W 10–25 g IV, glucagon if no IV
options.zh: 重度低血糖——静脉 D10W 10–25 g，建不了静脉用胰高血糖素

questions.explanationEn: Glucometers display 'LO' when the sample is below their lower measuring limit (on common meters roughly 1.1 mmol/L) and 'HI' above the upper limit (around 27.8 mmol/L) — the overflow message is 'HI', not 'LO'. A reading of 'LO' in an unresponsive, diaphoretic patient is severe hypoglycemia until proven otherwise, and the BC threshold for treatment is any BGL below 4.0 mmol/L. Oral glucose is contraindicated because he cannot protect his airway; the PCP gives D10W 10–25 g (100–250 mL) IV, with glucagon reserved for failed IV access. If you doubt the meter, repeat the test with a fresh strip and the second drop of blood — do not abandon the check, because missing a glucose before a protocol is a 100% deduction on the practical exam.
questions.explanationZh: 样本低于仪器测量下限（常见机型约 1.1 mmol/L）时显示「LO」，高于上限（约 27.8 mmol/L）时显示「HI」——溢出提示是「HI」，不是「LO」。无反应、出汗的患者读出「LO」，在证明不是之前就是重度低血糖，而 BC 的治疗阈值是任何 BGL 低于 4.0 mmol/L。口服葡萄糖禁用，因为他保护不了气道；PCP 静脉给 D10W 10–25 g（100–250 mL），建不了静脉才用胰高血糖素。怀疑仪器有问题，就换新试纸、用第二滴血重测——不能放弃血糖检查，因为启动规程前漏测血糖在实操考试里扣 100%。

questions.questionEn: A 49-year-old with 30 minutes of substernal pressure, nausea and diaphoresis has a completely normal 12-lead. What is the correct conclusion?
questions.questionZh: 49 岁男性胸骨后压迫感、恶心、出汗 30 分钟，12 导联完全正常。正确的结论是什么？

options.en: A normal 12-lead rules out ACS when symptoms have lasted 30 minutes
options.zh: 症状已持续 30 分钟，12 导联正常就能排除 ACS

options.en: ACS is not excluded — continue the protocol and repeat the 12-lead
options.zh: 不能排除 ACS——继续规程，复查 12 导联

options.en: Withhold ASA until the ECG shows evidence of infarction
options.zh: 等心电图出现梗死证据再给 ASA

options.en: Downgrade to a non-urgent transport to the nearest emergency department
options.zh: 降为非紧急转运，送最近的急诊

questions.explanationEn: The ECG is a snapshot of electrical activity at one moment; a significant share of infarcts show no ST changes on the first tracing, and unstable angina by definition has no infarct pattern — 30 minutes of symptoms does not change that. The symptom complex here — substernal pressure with nausea and sweating — is suggestive of cardiac chest pain, which is the BC protocol's indication in itself: ASA (no vitals needed first, and no ECG proof needed), nitroglycerin if SBP ≥110 and no other contraindication, oxygen for SpO₂ below 94%, vitals every 5 minutes and transport after the first nitro dose. Suspected cardiac chest pain is on the BC list of unstable findings, so this is never a non-urgent transport. Serial 12-leads catch the evolution a single tracing misses. The AET glossary makes the same point: a normal 12-lead does not rule out ACS — repeat it if suspicion remains.
questions.explanationZh: 心电图只是某一瞬间电活动的快照；相当一部分心梗第一份心电图没有 ST 改变，而不稳定型心绞痛按定义就没有梗死图形——症状持续了 30 分钟也改变不了这一点。本例的症状组合——胸骨后压迫感加恶心、出汗——提示心源性胸痛，这本身就是 BC 规程的指征：ASA（不需要先测生命体征，也不需要心电图证据）、SBP ≥110 且无其他禁忌时硝酸甘油、SpO₂ 低于 94% 时给氧、每 5 分钟测生命体征、第一剂硝酸甘油后转运。疑似心源性胸痛在 BC 的「不稳定」清单上，所以永远不是非紧急转运。连续复查 12 导联能捕捉单份心电图漏掉的演变。AET 术语表说的是同一件事：12 导联正常不能排除 ACS——仍有怀疑就复查。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old developed right-arm weakness and slurred speech 40 minutes ago. Why does the AET course insist on an exact last-known-well time and the fastest possible transport?
questions.questionZh: 68 岁男性 40 分钟前出现右臂无力、言语含糊。为什么 AET 课坚持要记录准确的「最后正常时间」并以最快速度转运？

options.en: Tissue around the core survives only if perfusion returns in time
options.zh: 核心周围的组织只有及时恢复灌注才能存活

options.en: Ischemic strokes convert to hemorrhage after the first hour
options.zh: 缺血性卒中在第一个小时后会转为出血

options.en: Thrombolysis is only offered to patients who arrive within 30 minutes of onset
options.zh: 溶栓只给发病 30 分钟内到院的患者

options.en: Stroke deficits worsen irreversibly once the patient is moved
options.zh: 患者一经搬动，卒中缺损就会不可逆地加重

questions.explanationEn: Around the core of infarcted tissue lies a ring of neurons that are too starved to fire but not yet dead — the penumbra. Every minute without flow converts more of it into core, which is why 'time is brain'. Thrombolysis and clot retrieval are offered within defined windows of hours, not 30 minutes, measured from the moment the patient was last seen normal, so an accurate LKW decides whether treatment is even possible. Hemorrhagic transformation is a complication, not a one-hour rule, and moving the patient is exactly what saves the penumbra. The BC stroke guideline's own steps reflect this: blood glucose check, FAST-VAN recognition, timely transport and notifying the receiving facility en route; the PCP adds an 18-gauge IV above the wrist, preferably on the right, without delaying departure.
questions.explanationZh: 梗死核心周围有一圈神经元，饿到无法放电但还没有死——这就是半暗带。每一分钟没有血流，就有更多半暗带变成核心，所以说「时间就是大脑」。溶栓和取栓的时间窗以小时计、而不是 30 分钟，从患者最后被看到正常的那一刻起算，所以准确的 LKW 决定了治疗是否可能。出血转化是并发症，不是什么「一小时规则」；而搬动患者恰恰是拯救半暗带的手段。BC 卒中指南的步骤也体现了这一点：查血糖、FAST-VAN 识别、及时转运、途中通知接收医院；PCP 在不耽误出发的前提下加做腕以上、首选右侧的 18 号静脉通路。

questions.questionEn: A 74-year-old insulin-dependent diabetic is found by her family with a left facial droop and slurred speech. Her glucometer reads 2.9 mmol/L. What comes first?
questions.questionZh: 74 岁胰岛素依赖型糖尿病女性被家人发现左侧面瘫、言语含糊。血糖仪读 2.9 mmol/L。先做什么？

options.en: Stroke pre-notification and immediate departure, treating glucose en route
options.zh: 先发卒中预警立即出发，血糖在途中处理

options.en: ASA 160 mg chewed, since a stroke is likely
options.zh: 很可能是卒中，嚼服 ASA 160 mg

options.en: Correct the hypoglycemia with D10W, then reassess the deficits
options.zh: 先用 D10W 纠正低血糖，再复评神经缺损

options.en: Glucagon 1 mg IM first, keeping the IV for the stroke centre
options.zh: 先肌注胰高血糖素 1 mg，静脉留给卒中中心用

questions.explanationEn: Hypoglycemia is the most common stroke mimic and the one you can reverse on scene; it can produce focal weakness, aphasia and facial asymmetry that vanish when the glucose is corrected. This is why the BC stroke guideline lists a blood glucose check among the interventions of all licence levels, and why the AET course calls it the 'glucose-first gate'. Her BGL is below the 4.0 mmol/L threshold, so the PCP starts an IV and gives D10W 10–25 g, then re-examines; a stroke alert sent before that risks a thrombolysis work-up for a patient who simply needed sugar. Glucagon is the PCP's fallback only when IV access fails — it is slower and unreliable in a patient with depleted glycogen. If the deficits persist after correction, the stroke pathway proceeds with the LKW clock. ASA is not part of the BC stroke guideline — a hemorrhage has not been excluded.
questions.explanationZh: 低血糖是最常见的卒中类似症，也是你在现场就能逆转的那一个；它能造成局灶性无力、失语和面部不对称，血糖纠正后就消失。所以 BC 卒中指南把查血糖列进所有执照级别的干预，AET 课也把它叫作「葡萄糖优先关口」。她的 BGL 低于 4.0 mmol/L 阈值，PCP 先开静脉给 D10W 10–25 g，再查体；在这之前就发卒中预警，可能让一个只是缺糖的人被推进溶栓流程。胰高血糖素只是 PCP 在静脉建不起来时的后备——起效慢，对糖原耗竭的患者也不可靠。纠正后缺损仍在，才按卒中路径走，并带上 LKW 的时钟。ASA 不在 BC 卒中指南里——出血尚未排除。

questions.questionEn: At the level of neurotransmitters, what drives a generalised seizure?
questions.questionZh: 从神经递质层面看，是什么驱动了全身性癫痫发作？

options.en: Excess GABA inhibition silencing the cortex
options.zh: GABA 抑制过度，让皮层「静默」

options.en: Glutamate excitation overwhelming GABA inhibition
options.zh: 谷氨酸兴奋压倒了 GABA 的抑制

options.en: Dopamine depletion in the basal ganglia
options.zh: 基底节多巴胺耗竭

options.en: Acetylcholine excess at muscarinic receptors
options.zh: 毒蕈碱受体处乙酰胆碱过多

questions.explanationEn: Normal cortical activity is a balance between glutamate, the main excitatory transmitter, and GABA, the main inhibitory one. When excitation outruns inhibition — from a lowered threshold, a lesion, withdrawal from a GABA-enhancing drug such as alcohol or a benzodiazepine, or a metabolic insult like hypoglycemia — large populations of neurons discharge together and a seizure results. Excess GABA would do the opposite and sedate the brain. Sustained glutamate overactivity also lets calcium flood the cells, which is the excitotoxic injury that makes prolonged seizures damaging. Dopamine deficit is the biology of Parkinson's disease, and muscarinic acetylcholine excess is the cholinergic toxidrome, not epilepsy.
questions.explanationZh: 正常的皮层活动是主要兴奋性递质谷氨酸和主要抑制性递质 GABA 之间的平衡。兴奋压过抑制时——阈值降低、病灶、酒精或苯二氮卓类这类增强 GABA 的药物戒断、低血糖之类的代谢打击——大量神经元一起放电，癫痫发作就出现了。GABA 过多的效果正好相反，是让大脑镇静。谷氨酸持续过度活动还会让钙离子涌入细胞，这就是让长时间发作造成损伤的兴奋性毒性。多巴胺不足是帕金森病的机制，毒蕈碱受体乙酰胆碱过多是胆碱能毒性综合征，不是癫痫。

questions.questionEn: A 25-year-old has been convulsing continuously for 15 minutes. Beyond the airway, which systemic consequences should you anticipate?
questions.questionZh: 25 岁男性持续抽搐 15 分钟。除了气道之外，还应预见哪些全身性后果？

options.en: Hypothermia and reflex bradycardia from vagal overactivity
options.zh: 迷走神经过度兴奋引起的低体温和反射性心动过缓

options.en: Hypertension that resolves without treatment
options.zh: 无需处理即可自行缓解的高血压

options.en: Hypoglycemia alone, from the muscle work
options.zh: 只有肌肉做功引起的低血糖

options.en: Hypoxia, acidosis, hyperthermia and rhabdomyolysis
options.zh: 缺氧、酸中毒、高热和横纹肌溶解

questions.explanationEn: Status epilepticus turns the whole body into an exercising muscle that cannot breathe properly: oxygen demand soars while ventilation is ineffective, so hypoxia and lactic acidosis develop; heat production drives the temperature up, not down; the sympathetic surge produces tachycardia and hypertension, not vagal bradycardia; and sustained contraction breaks down muscle fibres, releasing myoglobin and potassium that can injure the kidneys and destabilise the heart. The brain itself suffers excitotoxic damage the longer it goes on. Glucose may fall, but it is one item among several, and hypertension in this setting is a marker of strain rather than something that 'resolves'. Field priorities are oxygenation, protection from injury, a glucose check and rapid transport for drugs the PCP does not carry in BC.
questions.explanationZh: 癫痫持续状态把整个身体变成一块无法正常呼吸的运动中的肌肉：氧需求飙升而通气无效，于是出现缺氧和乳酸酸中毒；产热让体温升高而不是降低；交感风暴带来的是心动过速和高血压，不是迷走性心动过缓；持续收缩破坏肌纤维，释放出肌红蛋白和钾，可能损伤肾脏、扰乱心脏。持续越久，大脑本身的兴奋性毒性损伤越重。血糖可能下降，但那只是几项之一；此时的高血压是应激负荷的标志，不是什么「会自行缓解」的东西。现场重点是氧合、防止受伤、查血糖，并快速转运去获取 PCP 在 BC 不携带的药物。

questions.questionEn: You arrive to find a 32-year-old still convulsing after seven minutes; his lips are blue and he is gurgling. What is your first priority?
questions.questionZh: 你到场时 32 岁男性已抽搐 7 分钟仍未停止；口唇发绀，喉咙有咕噜声。你的首要任务是什么？

options.en: Position and open the airway, suction, high-flow oxygen, BVM ready
options.zh: 摆体位开放气道、吸引、高流量给氧、备好 BVM

options.en: Insert an oropharyngeal airway between the teeth with a tongue depressor
options.zh: 用压舌板把口咽通气道从牙齿之间放进去

options.en: Hold his limbs to stop the convulsion and prevent injury
options.zh: 按住四肢让抽搐停下来并防止受伤

options.en: Start an IV for D10W, since hypoglycemia is the likeliest cause
options.zh: 低血糖最可能，先开静脉给 D10W

questions.explanationEn: Cyanosis and gurgling mean he is not moving air and is at risk of aspirating. The sequence is the primary survey: move hazards away, pad the head, open the airway with positioning or a nasopharyngeal airway (an NPA is the adjunct of choice during trismus), suction secretions, give oxygen and ventilate if his effort fails. Glucose and vascular access come in the history-and-vitals step that follows — you cannot even know hypoglycemia is the cause until the glucometer says so. Forcing an OPA past clenched teeth breaks them and provokes vomiting, and restraining a seizing limb causes fractures without shortening the seizure; protection from injury means padding and clearing space, not holding him down.
questions.explanationZh: 发绀加咕噜声说明他没有有效通气，而且随时可能误吸。顺序就是初级评估：移开危险物、垫住头部、用体位或鼻咽通气道开放气道（牙关紧闭时 NPA 是首选辅助器具）、吸出分泌物、给氧，自主呼吸不行就通气。血糖和血管通路属于随后的病史与生命体征环节——血糖仪没出数之前，你根本不知道低血糖是不是病因。硬把口咽通气道塞过紧闭的牙关会弄断牙齿、诱发呕吐；按住抽搐的肢体会造成骨折，却不会缩短发作——防止受伤靠的是垫护和清出空间，不是把人按住。

questions.questionEn: A 34-week pregnant woman fell down a flight of stairs. Her HR is 100 and BP 112/70. Why can these numbers be falsely reassuring?
questions.questionZh: 一位孕 34 周的女性从楼梯上摔下。HR 100，BP 112/70。为什么这些数字可能给人假性的安心？

options.en: Pregnancy lowers resting heart rate, so 100 is severe tachycardia
options.zh: 怀孕会降低静息心率，所以 100 已经是严重的心动过速

options.en: Her expanded blood volume hides a loss of 1,200–1,500 mL
options.zh: 她增加的血容量能掩盖 1,200–1,500 mL 的失血

options.en: Third-trimester SBP normally sits near 90, so 112 is already high
options.zh: 妊娠晚期收缩压正常在 90 左右，所以 112 已经偏高

options.en: Fetal circulation is protected first, so maternal vitals change early
options.zh: 胎儿循环最先被保护，所以母亲的生命体征会最早变化

questions.explanationEn: By the third trimester plasma volume has risen more than red cell mass, giving a 40–50% larger circulating volume and a mild physiologic anemia; resting heart rate runs 10–20 above baseline (so 100 is unremarkable, not 'severe') and blood pressure is normal or slightly low — not down near 90. That reserve means a pregnant trauma patient compensates for a long time, and the compensation works by constricting the uterine vessels — so the first casualty of occult bleeding is the fetus, the reverse of the idea that the fetus is protected first. Treat the mechanism, not the numbers: oxygen, left lateral tilt if supine, early transport, and the PCP's hypovolemia protocol if signs of shock appear.
questions.explanationZh: 到妊娠晚期，血浆量的增加超过了红细胞量，循环血量比孕前多 40–50%，并出现轻度生理性贫血；静息心率比基线高 10–20（所以 100 并不起眼，谈不上「严重」），血压正常或略低——不会低到 90 附近。这份储备让孕期创伤患者能代偿很久，而代偿靠的正是收缩子宫血管——所以隐匿出血最先牺牲的是胎儿，和「胎儿最先被保护」正好相反。按受伤机制处理，别只看数字：给氧、仰卧时向左倾斜、尽早转运，出现休克征象时启动 PCP 的低血容量规程。

questions.questionEn: A woman at 32 weeks is lying flat on your stretcher after a minor collision. She turns pale and dizzy, and her BP drops to 84/50. What should you do first?
questions.questionZh: 一位孕 32 周的女性轻微碰撞后平躺在你的担架上。她面色转白、头晕，BP 降到 84/50。首先该做什么？

options.en: A 20 mL/kg normal saline bolus
options.zh: 20 mL/kg 生理盐水冲击

options.en: Epinephrine 0.5 mg IM for presumed anaphylaxis
options.zh: 按过敏性休克肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg

options.en: Head-down Trendelenburg position to raise her blood pressure
options.zh: 头低脚高位升压

options.en: Tilt her to the left or displace the uterus manually
options.zh: 让她向左倾斜，或用手把子宫推向左侧

questions.explanationEn: Lying supine, a gravid uterus of 20 weeks or more presses on the inferior vena cava and aorta, cutting venous return and cardiac output — supine hypotension, or aortocaval compression. The fix is mechanical and instant: roll her 15–30 degrees to the left, wedge the right hip, or push the uterus to the left by hand, which also applies when a trauma patient must stay on a spinal board. A fluid bolus treats a problem she does not have and would be given only if the hypotension persisted after repositioning with evidence of volume loss; epinephrine is for anaphylaxis, of which there is no sign; and Trendelenburg presses the uterus harder against the great vessels.
questions.explanationZh: 仰卧时，20 周以上的妊娠子宫会压迫下腔静脉和主动脉，减少静脉回流和心排量——这就是仰卧位低血压，也叫主动脉-腔静脉压迫。解决办法是机械性的、立竿见影的：让她向左转 15–30 度、右髋下垫楔子，或用手把子宫推向左侧，创伤患者必须留在脊柱板上时同样适用。液体冲击治的是她没有的病，只有改变体位后低血压仍在、并有容量丢失证据时才考虑；肾上腺素是给过敏性休克的，而她没有任何过敏征象；头低脚高位反而把子宫压得更紧。

questions.questionEn: In the AET course you learn that progesterone drives a mild chronic hyperventilation in pregnancy, so a normal late-pregnancy PaCO₂ is about 30 mmHg. A 36-week asthmatic in distress has an EtCO₂ of 42. How should you read that?
questions.questionZh: AET 课上学到：孕酮使孕妇出现轻度慢性过度通气，所以妊娠晚期正常的 PaCO₂ 约为 30 mmHg。一位孕 36 周的哮喘患者呼吸窘迫，EtCO₂ 42。该怎么解读？

options.en: Normal — 42 is inside the usual 35–45 range
options.zh: 正常——42 在通常的 35–45 范围内

options.en: Hyperventilation from anxiety about the baby
options.zh: 因担心胎儿而过度通气

options.en: Relative hypoventilation — she is tiring and failing
options.zh: 相对通气不足——她在疲惫、正走向衰竭

options.en: Compensated respiratory alkalosis
options.zh: 代偿性呼吸性碱中毒

questions.explanationEn: Reference ranges shift in pregnancy. Because the baseline PaCO₂ is already low, a value that would be unremarkable in a non-pregnant adult means a pregnant woman has lost her compensatory hyperventilation — she cannot keep up the extra work, and CO₂ is accumulating toward respiratory failure. Hyperventilation would drive the number down, not up, and rising CO₂ is acidotic, not alkalotic. The response is the same as for any failing asthmatic: oxygen, bronchodilators per protocol, left-tilted positioning, and a low threshold for assisted ventilation and rapid transport, remembering two patients depend on the result.
questions.explanationZh: 孕期的参考范围会变。因为基线 PaCO₂ 本来就低，一个在非孕成人身上不起眼的数值，对孕妇来说意味着她已经维持不住代偿性的过度通气——多出来的呼吸功她撑不住了，CO₂ 正在堆积、走向呼吸衰竭。过度通气会让数值下降而不是上升，CO₂ 升高是酸中毒而不是碱中毒。应对和任何濒临衰竭的哮喘患者一样：给氧、按规程用支气管扩张剂、左倾体位、放低辅助通气和快速转运的门槛——记住结局关系到两条命。

questions.questionEn: A 22-year-old from a party is agitated with dilated pupils, HR 138 and BP 170/100. Which single finding would point to a sympathomimetic rather than an anticholinergic toxidrome?
questions.questionZh: 一位 22 岁从派对回来的青年躁动不安，瞳孔散大，HR 138，BP 170/100。哪一项发现最能把拟交感毒性综合征和抗胆碱能毒性综合征区分开？

options.en: Drenching sweat
options.zh: 大汗淋漓

options.en: Pupils larger than 6 mm
options.zh: 瞳孔大于 6 mm

options.en: A heart rate above 130
options.zh: 心率超过 130

options.en: Agitation with paranoia
options.zh: 伴偏执的躁动

questions.explanationEn: Both toxidromes produce agitation, tachycardia, hypertension, hyperthermia and mydriasis, so pupil size, heart rate and behaviour cannot separate them. The discriminator is the sweat glands: sympathetic stimulation (cocaine, amphetamines, MDMA) drives profuse diaphoresis, whereas muscarinic blockade (antihistamine or tricyclic overdose, jimson weed) shuts the sweat glands off — 'hot as a hare, dry as a bone' — and often adds urinary retention and absent bowel sounds. The distinction matters for cooling and for anticipating complications, but the PCP's care is the same: scene safety, de-escalation, oxygen, glucose check, cooling for hyperthermia and transport with ALS intercept if unstable.
questions.explanationZh: 两种毒性综合征都有躁动、心动过速、高血压、高热和瞳孔散大，所以瞳孔大小、心率和行为都分不开它们。鉴别点在汗腺：交感兴奋（可卡因、安非他命、MDMA）引起大汗，而毒蕈碱受体被阻断（抗组胺药或三环类过量、曼陀罗）会让汗腺关闭——「热得像野兔、干得像骨头」——常伴尿潴留和肠鸣音消失。这个区分对降温和预判并发症有意义，但 PCP 的处置是一样的：现场安全、降级沟通、给氧、查血糖、高热时降温，不稳定时转运并请 ALS 会合。

questions.questionEn: A farm worker sprayed with an insecticide is drooling, tearing, vomiting and incontinent, with pinpoint pupils, wheezing full of secretions and a heart rate of 48. Which toxidrome is this, and what is the first concern?
questions.questionZh: 一名农场工人被杀虫剂喷到后流涎、流泪、呕吐、大小便失禁，瞳孔针尖样，哮鸣音中满是分泌物，心率 48。这是哪种毒性综合征，首要顾虑是什么？

options.en: Sympathomimetic — active cooling and benzodiazepines at hospital
options.zh: 拟交感——主动降温，到医院用苯二氮卓类

options.en: Anticholinergic — anticipate hyperthermia and urinary retention
options.zh: 抗胆碱能——预计高热和尿潴留

options.en: Opioid — naloxone 0.4 mg IM for the pinpoint pupils and slow breathing
options.zh: 阿片类——针尖样瞳孔、呼吸慢，肌注纳洛酮 0.4 mg

options.en: Cholinergic — crew protection and decontamination, then suction
options.zh: 胆碱能——先保护机组并去污，然后吸引

questions.explanationEn: Organophosphates block acetylcholinesterase, so acetylcholine floods every muscarinic receptor: the SLUDGE picture of salivation, lacrimation, urination, defecation, GI upset and emesis, plus the killer B's — bronchorrhea, bronchospasm and bradycardia. Pinpoint pupils with wet skin and copious secretions separate it from the opioid toxidrome, which is dry and silent, and the drenched, bradycardic patient is the opposite of the hot, dry anticholinergic or the tachycardic sympathomimetic. The patient is covered in a poison that absorbs through skin, so crew protection and removing contaminated clothing come before hands-on care; then the airway must be suctioned repeatedly and the patient oxygenated and ventilated, because the secretions will drown him. Atropine is the antidote at ALS or hospital level — it is not on the BC PCP formulary.
questions.explanationZh: 有机磷阻断乙酰胆碱酯酶，乙酰胆碱淹没所有毒蕈碱受体：流涎、流泪、尿失禁、便失禁、胃肠不适和呕吐的 SLUDGE 图像，再加上要命的三个 B——支气管溢液、支气管痉挛、心动过缓。针尖样瞳孔加湿漉漉的皮肤和大量分泌物，把它和又干又安静的阿片类毒性综合征区分开；而浑身湿透、心率缓慢，也正好与又热又干的抗胆碱能、心动过速的拟交感相反。患者身上沾满可经皮吸收的毒物，所以先保护好机组、脱掉污染衣物，再上手处理；随后要反复吸引气道、给氧、通气，因为分泌物会把他淹死。阿托品是 ALS 或医院层面的解毒剂——不在 BC 的 PCP 药物单上。
